【China to send new batch of humanitarian aid to Iran, Lebanon】June 17 — Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian said at a routine briefing that China will shortly deliver a new batch of humanitarian aid to Iran and Lebanon. Beijing, which provided emergency aid to Iran in mid‑March, said the assistance is tailored to local conditions and aims to support recovery, reconstruction and livelihoods. China said it will continue to provide support within its capacity and will work to encourage peace and promote talks to help restore order in the Middle East.

【中方在美菲壓力下撤出黃巖島設施？外交部：敦促有關國家立即停止造謠汙衊】6月17日，外交部發言人林劍主持例行記者會。有記者提問，據報道，在美菲壓力下，中方已經撤出此前在黃巖島安裝的所謂設施，中方對此有何評論？林劍表示，黃巖島是中國的固有領土，中國對黃巖島及其附近海域擁有無可爭辯的主權。5月下旬以來，中國科學院南海海洋研究所開展了覆蓋黃巖島、環礁全域的綜合調查。本次科考作業有利於深化對黃巖島生態系統的認知與預測，服務南海的生態文明建設現已順利完成。有關本次科考的詳細資訊，可以在該科研單位的官網上查閱。我要在這裡強調的是，中國在黃巖島開展包括科考在內的任何活動，都是主權國家的正當權力，他國無權干涉。中方敦促有關國家立即停止對中方的造謠汙衊和不實指責，停止在海上挑釁生事。（澎湃）

【Chinese Foreign Ministry says US should stop politicizing, instrumentalizing and weaponizing trade and technology issues】On June 17 at a regular briefing, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian was asked about reports the US Commerce Department had deferred adding several Chinese firms to its export-control entity list. Lin said China opposes broadening the national-security concept and the abuse of entity lists and other export-control tools to suppress Chinese companies, and urged the US to stop politicizing, instrumentalizing and weaponizing economic, trade and technology issues.
【外交部：美方應停止將經貿科技問題政治化、工具化、武器化】6月17日，外交部發言人林劍主持例行記者會。有記者提問，有報道稱，美國商務部暫緩將多家中國企業列入出口管制實體清單。請問中方對此有何評論？林劍表示，中方一貫反對美方泛化國家安全概念，濫用實體清單等出口管制的工具，遏制打壓中方企業，美方應停止將經貿科技問題政治化、工具化、武器化。（央視新聞）

FTSE 100 Treads Water After Inflation Report — The FTSE 100 traded close to flat on Wednesday as investors digested UK inflation data and awaited the Federal Reserve’s policy decision for further signals on the global interest rate outlook. Falling oil prices continued to weigh on the index, with energy majors Shell and BP both down around 1%. BAT and Rio Tinto also declined more than 1%, while Unilever slipped about 0.7%. On the upside, Rolls-Royce gained around 1.5% and AstraZeneca also traded higher. UK markets scaled back expectations for Bank of England rate increases this year after inflation unexpectedly remained unchanged in May, supporting a more cautious approach from some policymakers ahead of Thursday’s meeting. Meanwhile, Brent fell to a three-month low after dropping 15% over four sessions on expectations that a US-Iran agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz could boost supply and reduce inflation pressures. Investors are now turning their focus to the Federal Reserve’s latest decision and its view on future policy.

【日方決定延長持刀闖入中國使館的村田晃大的鑑定留置時間，繼續調查其是否具備刑事責任能力，外交部：再次敦促日方給中方一個負責任的交代】6月17日，外交部發言人林劍主持例行記者會。 有記者提問，據報道，針對日本自衛隊現役官員村田晃大非法持刀闖入中國駐日本使館，日本東京地方檢察廳決定延長對村田的鑑定留置時間，繼續調查其是否具備刑事責任能力。請問中方對此有何評論？ 林劍表示，日本自衛隊現役官員村田晃大非法持刀闖入中國駐日本使館案件發生已經過去了將近三個月，日方調查處置的程序緩慢，威脅中國駐日使領館安全的惡性事件還在不斷髮生。中方嚴重關切並多次提出交涉。此次的事件再次暴露出日本國記憶體在的諸多深層次的問題，包括日本國內右翼思潮和勢力猖獗，客觀理性的聲音受到壓制，日本政府在歷史、臺灣等涉及中日關係重大核心問題上的錯誤政策流毒深重，正確的歷史教育嚴重缺失，錯誤史觀大行其道，日本安保政策朝著進攻性、擴張性方向轉變。 日方對自衛隊失管失控，自衛隊內部失管失教。我們注意到一段時間以來，不少日方有識之士要求日政府對中方道歉，還有的敦促日政府對自衛隊內部管理、日方歷史教育及對華政策認真反思和整改，從根本上解決問題，剷除背後的社會土壤。我們再次敦促日方反思糾錯，徹底整改給中方一個負責任的交代。

【國信證券：首予海博思創“優於大市”評級，獨立儲能出貨有望快速增長】國信證券研報指出，海博思創26年第一季度實現歸母淨利潤2.0億元，同比+117%。公司是國內領先的大型儲能系統整合商，規模化交付能力持續驗證。公司長期聚焦電化學儲能系統研發、生產、銷售及服務，產品覆蓋大型儲能、工商業儲能及系統控制等多類場景，2025年公司累計裝機量超過50GWh。國內儲能需求由政策配儲轉向市場化收益驅動，公司獨立儲能出貨有望快速增長。近期公司簽訂美國2GWh儲能訂單，在北美市場實現重要突破，預期北美市場持續發展。該行認為公司合理價值區間為290.6-311.8元/股，對應2026年動態PE約26.1-28.0倍，相對當前股價具備約10%-18%上漲空間。首次覆蓋可考慮給予“優於大市”評級。
南非民主聯盟（DA）：希爾-劉易斯已要求拉馬福薩解除約翰·斯廷惠森農業部長的職務。

【分析師：比特幣在美聯儲決議公佈前小幅走低】隨著投資者在美聯儲政策決議公佈前對風險資產表現出謹慎態度，比特幣小幅下跌。倫敦證券交易所集團的資料顯示，市場幾乎充分預期利率將維持不變，但焦點在於美聯儲新任主席凱文·沃什對未來政策的立場。德意志銀行分析師在一份報告中表示，沃什可能會傾向於美聯儲公開市場委員會的中間立場，既不主張降息，也不排除加息的可能性。與此同時，伊朗外交部長阿巴斯·阿拉格齊表示，與美國達成和平協議取決於以色列從黎巴嫩撤軍，如果沒有這一點，戰爭就沒有完全結束。倫敦證券交易所集團的資料顯示，比特幣下跌0.4%，至65,522美元。
【韓國計劃將“民統線”向北移動】韓國國防部17日釋出軍事設施管制改革方案，計劃自2027年起分階段將現在的韓朝邊境“民間人出入統制線”（簡稱“民統線”）向北移動，由現在的平均距離韓朝軍事分界線約8公里處調整至約6公里處。韓國國防部長官安圭伯17日表示，此舉旨在適應新的安全環境，在保障軍事作戰需求的同時，改善邊境居民生產和生活條件，促進地方發展。（新華社）

Austria Inflation Rate Confirmed at 3.7% — The annual inflation rate in Austria rose 3.7% in May 2026 from 3.4% in the previous month, matching preliminary estimates. This marked the highest reading since November 2025, driven by faster price growth in transportation (8.8% vs. 7.7% in April) and miscellaneous goods and services (4.8% vs. 3.9%). Meanwhile, inflation remained steady in housing and utilities (3.3%), recreation and culture (1.0%), education (5.4%), and insurance and financial services (4.2%). Additionally, deflation eased in information and communication (-1.0% vs. -2.3%). On the other hand, price growth moderated in food and non-alcoholic beverages (2.2% vs. 2.4%), alcoholic beverages and tobacco (2.0% vs. 3.5%), health (4.4% vs. 4.5%), and restaurants and hotels (4.7% vs. 4.9%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices increased 0.1% in May, slowing from a 0.4% rise in the previous month. The harmonised inflation rate (HICP) also accelerated to 3.7% year-on-year from 3.4% in April.

【中國駐巴布亞紐幾內亞大使館提醒中國公民和機構切勿參與黃金走私、電信詐騙違法活動】近日，巴布亞紐幾內亞再次發生我公民因涉非法開採砂金和走私黃金被當地執法部門查獲、羈押和遣返等案件。同時，也出現電信詐騙苗頭。中國駐巴布亞紐幾內亞大使館再次鄭重提醒在巴新中國公民和機構，切勿從事非法採金和走私黃金活動，切實增強安全風險意識、確保人身財產安全，從事採金的中國企業應及時向使館報備。不參與、不協助、不隱瞞電信詐騙，警惕可疑人員、可疑活動，堅決抵制電信詐騙。發現可疑苗頭，及時舉報。如遇緊急情況第一時間報警並與中國駐巴新大使館聯絡尋求幫助。

【LBBW: New Fed chair Walsh's first press conference to be market focus】LBBW analysts say investors will focus on new Fed chair Kevin Walsh’s first press conference on Wednesday and expect his communication to be more restrained. The Fed is expected to hold policy rates at 3.50%–3.75% this month.
【美圖釋出奇想大模型V6，支援多模態輸入】美圖公司在2026美圖影像節上正式釋出了美圖奇想大模型V6，該模型支援文字、影象、影片、音訊等多模態輸入。此外，創始人吳欣鴻還宣佈設立了1億元的孵化基金，面向全球AI開發者徵集影像產品。參賽標準包括產品需為AI原生應用、與美圖影像賽道相關、已上線且具備種子使用者。

【ByteDance launches nationwide request for expressions of interest for integrated testing vendors for self-built data centers】ByteDance issued a nationwide request for expressions of interest (EOI) to build a framework pool of integrated testing and validation service providers for its self-built data-center facilities. It seeks vendors with large data-center testing capabilities. Required services include project documentation review, process inspections, equipment functional verification, room and subsystem performance testing, in-room system energy-efficiency testing, system integration testing and delivery of full test reports. Scope covers single-building delivered IT capacity of approximately 22MW–60MW.
【悅達投資等成立悅芯智慧科技公司 含AI及機器人業務】企查查APP顯示，近日，江蘇悅芯智慧科技有限公司成立，經營範圍包含：人工智慧行業應用系統整合服務；人工智慧基礎資源與技術平臺；工業機器人制造；智慧機器人的研發等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由悅達投資等共同持股。

【我國自主研發了OSCAR智慧編譯最佳化系統 攻克國產晶片編譯最佳化核心瓶頸】據大連理工大學訊息，近日，大連理工大學“雙擎智譯”科研團隊自主研發的OSCAR智慧編譯最佳化系統，攻克了國產晶片編譯最佳化核心瓶頸，有效提升國產處理器高效能編譯水平，為國產晶片效能迭代與生態建設提供了可靠技術方案。在國產處理器向高效能運算升級的過程中，編譯最佳化是充分釋放晶片底層算力、保障裝置適配性與執行穩定性的關鍵。長期以來，高階編譯最佳化技術門檻高、壁壘大，成為制約國產晶片效能發揮與生態完善的突出短板。

【位元組跳動釋出自建資料中心機房綜合測試服務供應商意向徵詢】今日位元組跳動釋出“自建資料中心機房綜合測試服務供應商意向徵詢”，面向全國範圍公開尋找具備大型資料中心綜合測試與驗證能力的服務商，建立綜合測試服務框架資源池。服務內容包括但不限於：完成機房樓專案資料審查、專案工藝檢查、裝置功能驗證、機房及子系統效能測試、機房內系統能效測試、系統聯調測試等工作，並出具完整測試報告。綜合測試服務需覆蓋的單棟機房樓交付IT容量約為22MW至60MW。

【Hikvision to raise HDD prices from July 1 as storage costs climb; launches "Guanlan encoding" to cut storage over 50% vs H.265】Market sources said Hikvision has sent price-adjustment letters to distributors, with HDD prices to rise effective July 1. Hikvision said global AI compute buildout and rising data storage demand have pushed some storage-product costs higher in Q3; it will monitor market conditions and seek to ensure stable supply and protect customers. To offset HDD price pressure, Hikvision launched video encoding "Guanlan encoding", driven by the Guanlan large model, using AI-enabled precision encoding to cut video bitrate while preserving image quality and AI application performance. Hikvision said "Guanlan encoding" reduces storage needs by more than 50% versus H.265 and can save up to 90% in some scenarios, aiming to lower customers' storage use and overall build costs.

【監管約談山姆後，沃爾瑪中國多位高管變動】 山姆會員商店中國 CMO（首席採購官）張青已於近日提交辭呈。對此，沃爾瑪中國回應稱：“衷心感謝她在任職期間對山姆業務作出的卓越貢獻，並誠摯祝願她在未來一切順利。目前我們正在全球範圍內積極物色繼任人選。過渡期間，Neil Maffey將出任代理山姆會員商店首席採購官。Neil曾於2013-2017年間擔任山姆首席採購官，卸任後長期擔任公司全職顧問至今。”此外，據瞭解，沃爾瑪中國本次人事變動還包括：Tony Paladinetti，現任沃爾瑪國際部戰略副總裁，將加入沃爾瑪中國，擔任沃爾瑪中國戰略副總裁，直接向朱曉靜彙報。內部郵件稱，Tony 將在完成工作簽證流程後於 2026 年 8 月正式加入中國團隊，並與妻子 Meg 及孩子一起搬遷至深圳。現任沃爾瑪中國戰略副總裁楊智安將直接向 Tony 彙報。過渡期間，Neil Maffey，前任山姆會員商店首席採購官及現任全職顧問，將擔任代理山姆會員商店首席採購官，直接向劉鵬，山姆會員商店業態總裁彙報，直至新負責人到崗。祝駿，沃爾瑪商店業態總裁將擴大其職責，分管沃爾瑪中國地產部。現任沃爾瑪中國地產部高階副總裁張晉元將直接向祝駿彙報。
【富信科技與北京科技大學順德創新學院產學研合作簽約】6月15日，廣東富信科技股份有限公司（簡稱“富信科技”）與北京科技大學順德創新學院舉行產學研合作簽約暨“產學研合作基地”“研究生聯合培養基地”揭牌儀式。雙方將依託富信科技在半導體熱電領域的技術積澱與產業優勢，以及北京科技大學的科研資源與人才力量，共同推動半導體熱電器件材料與系統整合的技術突破及產業化落地。

【Institutions preview Woshe press conference — first outing uncertain; hawkish or dovish remarks risk market pricing】UBS: Insufficient clarity on Woshe’s policy stance and reaction function; either a hawkish or dovish tilt could create market pricing risk. ANZ: Woshe appears intent on reforms; the press conference may outline reform ideas, with fuller detail likely at the Jackson Hole opening speech in August. BofA: Expects a dovish tone — Woshe may argue the Iran conflict only causes a one-off effect on price levels and should be ‘ignored’ by the Fed, especially after reports of potential resolutions. Capital Economics: Markets risk a more hawkish-than-expected delivery, whether from communication error or because his current stance is less dovish than when courting Trump’s nomination. Yale: Warns that overreliance on soft arguments like an ‘AI disinflation’ thesis while sidelining hard data risks repeating a ‘transitory inflation’ mistake. Nordea: Expects a neutral-to-slightly-hawkish posture to build credibility; any communication shift would be signaling rather than immediate policy action. BNY Mellon: Woshe has criticized forward guidance and may use the press conference — or limit future appearances — to signal changes to Fed communication under his tenure. MFS: Given his views on tech-driven productivity, dovish comments are possible but unlikely, since they would undermine a hawkish image.

【螞蟻阿福的2025：讓超8400萬三線及以下地區使用者就醫更簡單】6月17日，螞蟻集團釋出《2025年可持續發展報告》，報告顯示，過去一年螞蟻持續推動AI服務於人，讓就醫更簡單，生活更健康。其AI健康管家“螞蟻阿福”服務三線及以下地區使用者超8400萬（含阿福 App 和支付寶雙端資料）、超過30%使用者為中老年人；AI支付服務使用者中三線及以下地區使用者佔比40%；AI理財助理“螞小財”累計服務使用者超1億，全年發出1.2億次理性投資提醒。

【朝陽科技成立新公司 含無人飛行器業務】企查查APP顯示，近日，律笙（深圳）電子有限公司成立，經營範圍包含：服務消費機器人制造；服務消費機器人銷售；智慧無人飛行器製造；智慧無人飛行器銷售等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由朝陽科技全資持股。

【華泰證券：維持影石創新“增持”評級，正式切入手持雲臺相機主賽道】華泰證券日前研報指出，影石創新近期釋出新品Luna Ultra，正式切入手持雲臺相機主賽道。產品搭載雙徠卡鏡頭、可拆卸圖傳遙控屏與AI 三芯架構，強化畫質、操控與智慧拍攝體驗；相較於競品，公司新品更側重降低普通使用者創作門檻，有望形成差異化競爭，並開啟第二增長曲線。同時，公司聯手群核科技，推動業務邊界由影像裝置向空間智慧基礎解決方案延伸。認為Luna Ultra 首發熱銷驗證專業級便攜影像裝置的使用者付費意願，未來隨著高客單價新品逐步放量，收入結構有望向高價值量品類延展，維持“增持”評級。

【Report: China asset management industry likely to sustain >5% annual growth over next five years】China Everbright Bank and Everbright Wealth in Beijing released a China Asset Management Market 2024–2025 report saying the industry could sustain annual growth above 5% over the next five years, driven by rising total household wealth, a larger share of financial assets, greater wealth-management penetration and valuation support. Households are reallocating wealth away from property and deposits toward diversified financial assets, following a gradual pathway: fixed income as the base, progressive equity allocation and multi-strategy expansion. Against a backdrop of low deposit rates, retail demand remains focused on principal protection, keeping bank wealth-management and other fixed-income products as the primary safety cushion and main vehicle for flows. Expansion of personal pension schemes and a more developed ETF ecosystem should shift equity allocation from a niche of aggressive investors to marginal inflows from high-net-worth clients and long-duration institutional capital.

【《中國資產管理市場2015-2026》今日正式釋出：中國資管行業在未來五年或將持續保持5%以上的年增長率】中國光大銀行、光大理財在北京正式釋出《中國資產管理市場2024—2025》報告。報告顯示，在居民總財富、金融資產佔比、財富管理滲透率及估值因子四大因素驅動下，我國資管行業未來五年或將持續保持5%以上的年增長率。報告同時指出，當前我國居民財富從房地產和存款轉向多元金融資產，正在形成一條“固收為基、權益漸進、多策並舉”的漸進式路徑。在“存款利率1時代”背景下，居民對本金安全的訴求依然壓倒對高風險收益的追逐。因此，以銀行理財為代表的固收類產品憑藉其低波穩健的特性，將繼續充當資金轉移的“安全氣囊”和主要載體。同時，隨著個人養老金制度的擴圍與 ETF 生態的完善，權益類資產的配置將不再僅僅是少數激進者的博弈，而是逐步演變為高淨值客戶與長期資金的“邊際增量”選擇。

Steel Drops to Two-Month Low — Steel rebar futures declined to around CNY 3,120 per ton, reaching their lowest level in two months as disappointing economic data from China weighed on demand expectations. Crude steel production in the world's largest producer continued to weaken amid a prolonged downturn in the property sector, with May output falling 2.7% year-on-year to 84.35 million tons. Broader economic indicators also pointed to slowing momentum, with fixed-asset investment and consumer spending retreating to levels last seen during the pandemic period. Meanwhile, earlier data showed China's steel exports rose 8.8% in May from the previous month, supported by subdued domestic demand and stronger profit margins for overseas shipments. However, cumulative steel exports in the first five months of the year were still down 8.1% from a year earlier, reflecting rising trade barriers in several major export markets.

British Pound Weakens After Softer Inflation — The British pound edged lower to $1.34 as traders digested a softer-than-expected inflation report ahead of the Bank of England’s monetary policy decision on Thursday. UK consumer price inflation unexpectedly held steady at 2.8% in May, below expectations of a rise to 3%. Core inflation increased to 2.6%, slightly under forecasts of 2.7%, while services inflation accelerated to 3.7% from 3.2%, broadly in line with expectations. The data suggested that underlying price pressures were less pronounced than feared, reinforcing the cautious, wait-and-see approach favored by some Bank of England policymakers. The central bank is widely expected to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.75% this month as it balances still-elevated inflation against a weakening labor market and an economic contraction in April. Investors expect only a single rate increase this year, with a 25bps rise not fully anticipated until December.

【長城證券：首予恩捷股份“買入”評級，前瞻佈局固態電池趨勢】長城證券研報指出，恩捷股份是全球隔膜龍頭，前瞻佈局固態電池趨勢。公司主營業務涵蓋鋰電池隔離膜、BOPP薄膜、無菌包裝及特種紙，其中隔膜業務為核心，2025 年收入佔比達85.31%，收入結構高度集中且穩定。公司隔膜已進入全球主流電池廠供應體系，市場份額連續多年位居行業第一，產能與出貨量持續領先。在此基礎上，公司積極向固態電池材料延伸，在硫化鋰、固態電解質及電解質膜等環節推進佈局，逐步形成從傳統隔膜向新一代電池材料延伸的業務體系。隔膜迎來供需拐點，盈利開啟修復。圍繞硫化物路線構建全鏈條佈局，卡位固態電池。公司為鋰電隔膜龍頭，前瞻固態電池趨勢佈局硫化物體系固態電解質。首次覆蓋，給予“買入”評級。

【海康威視推出”觀瀾編碼”應對硬碟漲價】海康威視相關人士表示，近期，受全球AI算力建設和資料儲存需求持續增長影響，第三季度部分儲存產品成本出現一定幅度上漲。海康威視將持續關注市場變化，努力保障產品穩定供應和客戶利益。 為應對硬碟價格上漲帶來的挑戰，海康威視持續推進技術創新，推出觀瀾大模型驅動的影片編碼技術“觀瀾編碼”，全面佈局到前後端產品。依託AI精準編碼能力，在保障影象質量和智慧應用效果的前提下，可有效降低影片位元速率，相較於H.265可節約50%以上的儲存空間，部分場景最高可節省90%的儲存空間，顯著降低客戶儲存資源佔用和總體建設成本。 觀瀾編碼利用觀瀾大模型精準提取物件，給予物件和背景不同的量化系統策略，對感興趣區域精准保護；採用H.26X的紋理編碼技術，實現既大幅降低儲存成本，又保證關鍵資訊不丟失，不影響智慧分析，且觀瀾編碼廣泛相容，用H.26X標準解碼，保障編碼還原真實。（第一財經）

【英國通脹資料低於預期後英鎊下跌】英國5月份同比通脹率維持在2.8%，低於3.0%的平均預期，此後英鎊兌歐元跌至近兩週低點。核心通脹率從4月份的2.5%升至2.6%，低於預期的2.7%。Capital.com的Daniela Hathorn在一份報告中表示，對英國央行而言，該資料“降低了”潛在加息需求相關的”部分緊迫性”。倫敦證券交易所集團的資料顯示，預計英國央行週四將維持利率不變，但市場預計到12月將會加息。資料公佈後，歐元兌英鎊從資料公佈前的0.8645英鎊升至0.8653英鎊的12天高點。英鎊兌美元從之前的1.3428美元跌至1.3409美元的盤中低點。

【機構預計A股震盪走強，AI尚未泡沫化，A500ETF南方（159352）漲超1%】6月17日，A500ETF南方（159352）交投活躍，截至發稿漲1.19%，成交額27.81億元。長江證券表示，在全球AI資本開支加速和國內企業盈利修復的背景下，預計A股市場震盪走強，AI基建+能源安全仍是主線。配置方向上，關注AI基建+資源品兩條主線。一是鑑於科技資本開支超預期，推薦AI硬體，如光模組、儲存、晶片等方向，同時關注提升算力效率的新技術路線-先進封裝，重點關注封測製造、玻璃基板等；二是鑑於美伊衝突逐步緩解，關注有色、化工、機械、汽車等方向。西部證券認為，本輪牛市需要改變AI和“漲價”順週期對立的“二極體思維”兼顧高波動的AI和高賠率的“漲價”順週期。AI尚未泡沫化，成長投資者需要接受AI算力硬體（通訊裝置/半導體/儲存等）的高波動性；PPI漲價終將傳導到CPI，價值投資者既要把握PPI漲價鏈（煤炭/石油/化工/新能源），也要耐心等待下半年“資產負債表修復”有望修復並驅動的CPI漲價鏈（地產/白酒等）。投資者可借道A500ETF南方（159352）及其聯接基金（A類022434；C類022435）一鍵佈局。

【65家中國機構躋身2026全球資管500強 首登亞洲第一】6月17日，“歐洲投資與養老金”（Investment&PensionsEurope，簡稱IPE）釋出“2026全球資管500強”榜單。65家中國資產管理機構上榜，包括27家基金管理公司、18家銀行理財公司、15家保險資產管理公司以及5家證券公司。其中，中國人壽資產管理有限公司排名29位，成為全球前30強中唯一的亞洲機構，並首次登頂亞洲第一。據悉，該榜單以2025年12月31日為資料基準日，統一以歐元計量資產管理規模（AUM），對全球主要資產管理機構進行跨時間、跨市場的標準化比較。榜單排名受到匯率與市場的雙重影響。

Iron Ore Sinks to Two-Month Low — Iron ore futures dropped toward CNY 750 per ton, reaching their lowest level in two months as ample supply and weakening demand in China continued to weigh on the market. Crude steel production in China has remained under pressure amid a prolonged downturn in the property sector, with May output declining 2.7% year-on-year to 84.35 million tons. Broader economic indicators also disappointed, with fixed-asset investment and consumer spending retreating to levels not seen since the pandemic period. On the supply side, Guinea’s Simandou mine continued to ramp up production, with output rising to 2.2 million tons in May from 1.3 million tons in April. Meanwhile, iron ore inventories at Chinese ports climbed to record highs as demand from steelmakers softened. Adding to bearish sentiment, China’s iron ore imports fell nearly 6% in May from the previous month, defying expectations for an increase, as mills limited purchases to immediate needs ahead of a seasonally weaker demand period.

【美元在美聯儲決議公佈前走勢平穩】隨著投資者等待美聯儲公佈政策決定，美元走勢平穩。市場普遍預計美聯儲將維持利率不變，但市場將從美聯儲新任主席凱文·沃什那裡尋找有關未來政策方向的線索。德國商業銀行的Antje Praefcke在一份報告中表示，沃什不太可能在作為主席的首次會議上透過直接投票支援降息來採取強烈反對美聯儲的立場。她表示，對於美元而言，決定性因素將是他是否將能源價格衝擊描述為暫時的，並使得市場對未來加息的預期顯得不合理。DXY美元指數持平於99.554。

【英特爾18A-P製程進入風險生產階段】據報道，英特爾宣佈其18A製程節點的升級版本“18A-P”，已正式進入風險生產（risk production）階段。英特爾18A-P製程基於去年第四季度量產的18A，針對資料中心CPU以及人工智慧和高效能運算 (HPC) 半導體的生產進行了最佳化。與18A相比，18A-P在相同功耗下效能提升高達9% ；在相同效能水平下，功耗最多可降低18%。此外，英特爾計劃利用18A-P生產“Diamond Rapids” CPU 晶片，預計將於明年釋出。

【螞蟻國際張克強：AI驅動跨境信貸餘額同比增逾60%】螞蟻國際跨境信貸事業部總經理張克強在2026數字金融發展論壇上表示，依託上海國際金融中心建設政策及人才優勢，螞蟻國際已在滬設立全球最大運營中心，AI驅動數字支付與金融服務方案已輸出至全球220多個市場。螞蟻國際跨境場景金融日均信貸餘額5月同比增長60%以上。針對出海企業面臨的全球支付、本地化營銷及資金週轉三大痛點，公司推出“支付合規×商業數字化×信任構建”三重引擎戰略；同時推出移動智慧體協議AMP，聯合千問、Gemini等主流AI平臺，填補智慧體移動支付標準空白。
巴克萊將STOXX 600指數2026年年底目標從620點上調至670點。

【曝位元組調整AI資源重心 從大眾產品轉向企業服務】截至上半年，豆包每日使用使用者超2億人，但每日收入不足百萬元，主要來自電商佣金。而到今年 5 月，參照火山引擎公開API 價格，結合豆包大模型的毛利率及豆包使用者使用習慣推算，豆包每天日消耗的算力成本達數千萬元。 報道還指出，兩個月前，有位元組高層到訪Anthropic，回國後不久，公司便開始調整AI資源分配策略，將重心從豆包這類面向大眾的產品轉向服務企業的產品。 報道稱，位元組Seedance已證明企業服務的方向可行。目前，Seedance年化收入（ARR）已達20億美元（約合143億元人民幣），單月超過10億元，幾乎可覆蓋豆包產生的算力成本。其絕大部分收入來自企業客戶，不過，Seedance的收入增速近期已有所放緩。（晚點）

South Korean Shares Hit New Record — The benchmark KOSPI climbed 1.58% to close at a fresh record high of 8,864 on Wednesday, reversing earlier losses, as improved global risk sentiment supported Asian equities ahead of the Federal Reserve’s policy decision. Gains tracked higher US stock futures and a broadly firmer tone across regional markets, reinforcing risk appetite after recent volatility. Semiconductor stocks led the advance, with Samsung Electronics edging higher by 0.87% and SK Hynix jumping 5.88%, helping support index-heavyweight performance. Other notable increases were seen in SK Square (6.33%), LG Energy Solution (1.34%), HD Hyundai Heavy Industries (1.29%), and Hanwha Aerospace (3.63%). Meanwhile, investors remained positioned ahead of the FOMC decision, with markets largely expecting unchanged rates while assessing signals on the future policy path under Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.
Barclays raised its 2026 year-end target for the STOXX Europe 600 to 670 from 620.
【半導體港股漲幅擴大 兆易創新漲14%】截至發稿，兆易創新(03986.HK)漲14%，華虹宏力(01347.HK)漲9%，中芯國際(00981.HK)漲3%。訊息面上，SEMI釋出的報告顯示，2026年第一季度全球半導體裝置出貨金額同比增長14%，達到365.5億美元，環比增長1%。

【美伊協議改善原油供應預期，中東原油價差轉為貼水】資料顯示，本週中東原油市場行情大幅走弱，各油種報價轉為貼水。此前美伊達成框架協議，計劃重啟關鍵航運要道霍爾木茲海峽，全球原油供應預期隨之改善。基準迪拜原油相對掉期價差週一曾升至每桶 2.06 美元，重回衝突前水平；週二價差轉為貼水 46 美分，為今年 1 月以來首次出現遠期升水行情。同步來看，週二阿曼現貨原油、穆爾班原油價差分別轉為貼水 67 美分、49 美分。
【野村稱當前財季批發業務收入增長30% 主要受股票產品推動】野村控股表示，核心交易和投資銀行業務的收入本財季以來大幅增長，表明此前推動該公司去年錄得創紀錄利潤的勢頭還在持續。該公司在網站公告中表示，當前財季截至6月12日，批發業務收入“同比增長超過30%”。該公司稱，增長“主要由股票產品推動”。野村股價在業績指引發布後一度上漲4.5%，今年以來累計漲幅達到12%。

ASX 200 Closes at Two-Month High — The ASX 200 rose 49 points, or 0.5%, to finish at 8,966 on Wednesday, extending gains for a fourth session and notching a two-month peak. Sentiment was lifted by firmer U.S. futures ahead of Kevin Warsh’s first Federal Reserve meeting. At the same time, key details emerged on the interim U.S.-Iran agreement, which allows oil tanker passage through Hormuz in exchange for lifting port blockades. Locally, the Reserve Bank of Australia held cash rates at 4.35% Tuesday, in line with estimates, as the board balanced slowing growth against sticky inflation. Most sectors advanced, led by producer manufacturing, consumer services, and non-energy minerals. Index heavyweight BHP Group rose 0.6%, briefly hitting a record high. Meanwhile, gold miners surged as bullion rallied on Middle East news, with Northern Star up 2.5% and Regis 6.1%. Three of the four major banks added between 0.2% and 1.2%. In contrast, Karoon Energy slumped 13.4% after cutting its annual output forecast.
Philippine stock index rose 2%.
Canadian prime minister Carney said the U.S. and Trump are shifting toward a more pragmatic stance on Ukraine.

【Pakistan says 30 Iranian nationals to be repatriated】Pakistan will assist the repatriation of 30 Iranian nationals in the coming days: 8 fishermen rescued at sea by UK vessel MMA Valour after their boat grounded, and 22 crew from the vessel Lenore/Davina recently intercepted by US authorities. The groups are expected to transit Karachi; Pakistan says it is coordinating with Iranian, US and UK authorities to secure their safe transfer and return.

【6月17日：“農產品批發價格200指數”比昨天下降0.10個點】據農業農村部監測，6月17日“農產品批發價格200指數”為112.72，比昨天下降0.10個點，“菜籃子”產品批發價格指數為112.66，比昨天下降0.10個點。截至今日14:00時，全國農產品批發市場豬肉平均價格為14.75元/公斤，比昨天上升1.2%；牛肉66.65元/公斤，比昨天下降0.1%；羊肉64.25元/公斤，比昨天上升0.8%；雞蛋10.53元/公斤，比昨天下降1.2%；白條雞17.09元/公斤，比昨天下降0.7%。重點監測的28種蔬菜平均價格為4.33元/公斤，比昨天上升0.9%；重點監測的6種水果平均價格為7.44元/公斤，比昨天上升0.1%。鯽魚20.16元/公斤，比昨天上升0.5%；鯉魚14.41元/公斤，比昨天下降1.2%；白鰱魚10.48元/公斤，比昨天上升1.9%；大帶魚40.81元/公斤，比昨天下降1.3%。今日，國內鮮活農產品批發市場重點監測的46個品種中，與昨天相比價格升幅前五名的是西紅柿、蓮藕、菠蘿、蔥頭和黃瓜，幅度分別為3.5%、3.2%、2.8%、2.1%和2.1%；價格降幅前五名的是平菇、大帶魚、鯉魚、雞蛋和南瓜，幅度分別為2.0%、1.3%、1.2%、1.2%和0.8%。

【LG Innotek plans further FCBGA substrate expansion】LG Innotek’s packaging solutions head said on the 16th the company will invest 1 tln won to build a semiconductor substrate plant in Vietnam as the first phase of expanding its packaging substrate business. It is negotiating a second-phase investment to enlarge FCBGA capacity for AI servers; discussions have made substantive progress and the company expects to announce scale soon. LG Innotek also plans additional FCBGA expansion at its Gumi, North Gyeongsang factory in South Korea beyond a previously announced 600 bln won investment, scaling production according to customer-agreed volumes.

【美騰科技起訴晉能控股煤業集團下屬馬道頭煤業，追討近兩千萬元合同款和違約金】6月16日，美騰科技（688420）釋出公告，該公司因與大同煤礦集團馬道頭煤業有限責任公司發生買賣合同糾紛，向山西省左雲縣人民法院提起訴訟，請求判令馬道頭煤業立即支付合同款1794萬元並支付違約金，合計金額為1973萬元。據財中社報道，2023年3月，美騰科技與馬道頭煤業簽訂裝置採購合同，並已依約履行相關合同義務，但馬道頭煤業未依約及時支付合同價款。根據美騰科技的上述公告，其目前就這起訴訟已經收到法院的《受理案件通知書》，案件尚未開庭審理。（澎湃）

【機構：英國通脹持平確保英國央行本週將維持利率不變】MHA的Joe Nellis在一份報告中表示，5月份通脹率保持不變，幾乎肯定意味著英國央行週四不會加息。5月份同比通脹率為2.8%，與上月持平，且低於預期。Nellis說：“英國央行繼續保持鎮定，當下他們正在監測控制通脹與避免對經濟造成進一步損害之間艱難且持續的權衡。”在中東保持和平、通脹率可能保持在4%以下的背景下，英國央行今年可能根本不需要加息。Nellis補充說，儘管如此，即使中東緊張局勢迅速得到解決，未來幾個月通脹率仍可能小幅走高。

Hungary Gross Wage Growth Eases in April — Hungary’s gross average wages rose 9% year-on-year to HUF 772,200 in April 2026, easing from a 9.2% increase in the previous month. Wage growth in the public sector moderated to 10.7% from 11.8% in March, while earnings growth also slowed in the non-profit sector to 7.6% from 10.1%. In contrast, wage growth in the private sector accelerated to 8.7% from 8.4%. Additionally, gross wages excluding one-off payments and bonuses increased 8.4% year-on-year to HUF 711,400 in April. In the first four months of 2026, average gross wages rose 13.4% from the same period a year earlier, reaching HUF 779,500.

【英國前衛生大臣：最快下週就會發起工黨領袖競選】英國前衛生大臣韋斯・斯特里廷接受採訪時表示，他最快下週就會發起工黨領袖競選，取代基爾・斯塔默出任首相，同時呼籲儘快結束當下政壇的 “不確定性與治理停滯”。斯特里廷稱，自己已獲得發起黨內挑戰所需的 81 名工黨議員支援。他在 BBC《新聞之夜》節目中表示，黨內領袖之爭宜早不宜遲。斯特里廷表示：“我認為應當給首相留出週末這段時間冷靜反思，之後我們再看局勢如何發展。”
Swedish survey firm Origo Group: all respondents expect 12-month inf of 1.7%, up from 1.6% in the March survey.

【LG Innotek計劃進一步擴產FCBGA基板】LG Innotek封裝解決方案事業部負責人趙智泰16日表示，將投資1萬億韓元在越南建設半導體基板廠，這是其擴充套件封裝基板業務部門的第一階段投資；公司還在與客戶洽談第二階段投資，以擴大用於AI伺服器的FCBGA產能，“討論已經取得了實質性進展，我們很快就能公佈規模。” 此外，LG Innotek還計劃在韓國慶尚北道龜尾市工廠進一步擴產，除了此前宣佈的6000億韓元投資外，公司還計劃根據與客戶約定的產量，繼續擴大FCBGA生產規模。（科創板日報）

【四川：2026年前五個月規上工業增加值同比增長6% 房地產投資同比下降7.8%】6月17日，四川省統計局官微釋出2026年1-5月全省國民經濟主要指標資料，前5個月，四川省規模以上工業增加值同比增長6%，規模以上工業企業產品銷售率為95.1%。分產品看，天然氣產量同比增長2%，發電量增長2.4%，智慧電視增長59.2%，鋰離子電池增長57.2%，積體電路增長18.4%，工業機器人增長12.3%，液晶顯示屏增長9.3%。

【泰國計劃加快液化天然氣投資以滿足資料中心需求】泰國能源部一名高階官員表示，由於新建資料中心將大幅推高電力需求，泰國計劃加快液化天然氣基礎設施及天然氣勘探領域投資。泰國能源部常任秘書巴瑟・辛蘇克普拉瑟特於週三向記者透露，政府正在起草新版電力發展規劃，保障規劃內資料中心的電力充足供應；這批資料中心全面投產後預計總耗電規模達 20000 兆瓦。當局正考慮在泰國液化天然氣核心樞紐羅勇府擴建液化天然氣分餾廠與進口接收站。巴瑟稱，現有設施年液化天然氣處理能力約 2000 萬噸。政府同時在研究安達曼海天然氣田的開發可行性，此前因開發成本過高，該海域尚未開展任何勘探專案。

【世界銀行集團批准為阿根廷提供融資擔保】世界銀行集團16日批准一項擔保融資計劃，以幫助阿根廷獲得20億美元商業貸款，推動該國重返國際資本市場。 世行集團在一份宣告中說，該計劃包括兩項擔保，一項為來自國際復興開發銀行的政策性擔保，另一項是來自多國投資保證機構的擔保。該計劃可支援高達20億美元的商業貸款，助力阿根廷降低融資成本並加強公共債務管理。 分析人士指出，在獲得世行集團擔保的情況下，阿根廷有望在今年第三季度透過發行主權債券重返國際資本市場。(新華社)

【美一小飛機在高速路墜毀1人死亡】當地時間6月16日晚，一架小型飛機在美國得克薩斯州拉雷多市的20號環線高速公路墜毀。機上共有6人，事故造成1人死亡。現場影片顯示，多名路過的車主紛紛棄車，試圖砸碎駕駛艙窗戶，救出被困人員。這條高速公路一度雙向封閉。（CCTV國際時訊）

【BNY Mellon: FOMC statement likely to flag two-way risks to rates】BNY Mellon Americas head of strategy John Velis expects the upcoming FOMC statement to explicitly flag two-way risks to short-term interest rates, consistent with the three dissents at the late-April meeting. The Summary of Economic Projections (dot plot) will be released; Velis anticipates the 2026 year-end median will drop the prior single-cut easing expectation that had appeared in earlier cycles.

【Sichuan Jan-May 2026 industrial value added +6% YoY; property investment -7.8% YoY】Sichuan Provincial Bureau of Statistics: Jan-May 2026 industrial value added of above-designated-size enterprises rose 6% YoY; product sales rate 95.1%. Fed to Keep Rates Steady at New Chair's First Meeting — The Federal Reserve is widely expected to keep the federal funds rate unchanged at 3.50%-3.75% for a fourth consecutive meeting in June 2026, as policymakers navigate persistent inflation and uncertainty over the pace at which price pressures will ease. This meeting will be the first under new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, whose appointment was initially viewed as leaning toward interest rate cuts and policy easing; however, market expectations have since shifted toward a more hawkish stance. Although the US and Iran have agreed to a provisional peace deal, oil prices remain above pre-war levels, while recent labour market data has pointed to continued strength in employment. Investors will closely watch the Fed’s updated economic projections, including the “dot plot,” for signals on the future path of interest rates. However, many analysts expect that new Chair Warsh will not participate in it. Back in March, the Fed had previously projected one rate cut in 2026 and another one in 2027.

【德意志銀行：寶馬下調預期的幅度超預期】德意志銀行分析師Tim Rokossa寫道，市場原本預計寶馬會修正其預期，但下調的幅度超出了預期。Rokossa指出，該股最近表現不佳，且該公司取消了計劃已久的執行長與投資者會議。德意志銀行表示，現在的問題多於答案，6月底在美國舉行的投資者更新會議以及7月底的第二季度業績可能不會提供更多細節。該行將該股目標價從100歐元下調至90歐元，並維持買入評級。

China 10Y Yield Falls on PBOC Policy Shift Signals — China's 10-year government bond yield fell to 1.73% on Wednesday, hitting a fresh one-week low as investors assessed signals that the People's Bank of China could adjust its monetary policy framework. Speaking at the Lujiazui Forum, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng said the central bank would optimize its management of short-term interest rates and expand its overnight reverse repo operations at an appropriate time. The remarks reinforced expectations that the PBOC may gradually transition away from relying on the seven-day reverse repo rate as its main policy anchor, aligning its operating framework more closely with those of major global central banks while enhancing its control over short-term funding conditions. Separately, at the same forum, Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng said Beijing plans to incorporate anti-sanctions provisions into its financial legislation, aiming to strengthen the country's ability to counter what he described as "unreasonable" external restrictions.

Offshore Yuan Holds Near a Multi-Year High — The offshore yuan traded around 6.75 per dollar on Wednesday, remaining close to its strongest level since February 2023 after the People's Bank of China unveils fresh measures designed to deepen global usage of the Chinese currency. The central bank said it will expand access to yuan liquidity through its Foreign and International Monetary Authorities (FIMA) repo facility, enabling foreign central banks, sovereign wealth funds, and other official institutions to borrow yuan against holdings of Chinese government bonds and other eligible securities. The announcement marks another step in Beijing's long-running campaign to internationalize the yuan and reduce reliance on the US dollar in global finance. Reflecting this ambition, China's latest five-year plan pledged to advance yuan internationalization, while President Xi Jinping has emphasized the objective of building a strong and influential global currency.

【米哈遊訴多摩萬事屋勝訴】6月17日，米哈遊法務部發文：米哈遊訴“多摩萬事屋”著作權侵權及不正當競爭糾紛一案迎來終審判決。上海智慧財產權法院二審駁回上訴，維持一審法院判決，即判令各被告立即停止侵權、公開發布宣告消除影響，並連帶賠償米哈遊經濟損失及合理開支共計298萬元。 “多摩萬事屋”是一家在全國多地開設連鎖門店的線下商業集合店鋪，其背後涉及多家關聯企業主體。該店鋪打著“同人二創”的旗號，以企業身份進行大規模商業化經營： 1.以直營及加盟方式在全國開設了數十家門店，大量收購同人作品後，貼附自家品牌標識進行二次包裝，再在店內大量銷售未經授權的《原神》《崩壞：星穹鐵道》《未定事件簿》《絕區零》《崩壞3》等周邊產品； 2.經取證，涉案商品涵蓋徽章、立牌、擺件等品類，涉及141個遊戲角色、共計1500餘款商品； 3.對外進一步開展加盟業務，將侵權經營進行規模化擴張。 一審訴訟中，“多摩萬事屋”試圖將侵權責任推卸給二創作者，聲稱“如果是侵權商品，那構成侵權的也是同人畫師或社團”。但米哈遊認為，即使“多摩萬事屋”敗訴，也無權向同人作者追責。 一審法院經審理認定，“多摩萬事屋”的行為構成著作權侵權及不正當競爭。判令各被告停止侵權、消除影響，並連帶賠償298萬元。 一審判決後，“多摩萬事屋”不服並提起上訴，辯稱自身僅為“寄售方”而非生產者。上海智慧財產權法院二審對此予以明確否定，認定其自行選品、主動貼附自有標識並透過特定渠道銷售，已使公眾認為商品來源於該店鋪，“生產者”身份依法成立，應當承擔相應侵權責任。這一認定也避免了侵權責任被惡意轉嫁給二創作者。

【諾和諾德全球CEO：未來會增加在中國的BD交易，口服減重版司美將遞交上市申請】“我們一直與許多中國公司對話，並將繼續下去。當我們找到合適的公司或分子，能補充我們感興趣的領域時，我們不會猶豫提出報價。”6月16日，諾和諾德公司全球總裁兼執行長杜麥克（Maziar Mike Doustdar）在接受澎湃新聞記者採訪時表示，未來諾和諾德在中國的BD交易會增加，這是肯定的。此前口服減重版司美格魯肽已經在美國獲批，對於該口服減肥藥在中國的進展，杜麥克透露：“我們很快將提交口服減重版司美格魯肽在中國的監管審批申請。我們說的是幾周或幾個月。”（第一財經）

【菲律賓進入能源緊急狀態 東南亞能源安全敲響警鐘】國際能源署16日釋出報告說，伊朗戰事引發的能源危機給東南亞地區能源安全敲響警鐘，如果不盡快改變能源供應渠道單一的情況，該地區能源進口成本將大幅增加。報告說，東南亞地區過度依賴經霍爾木茲海峽運輸的石油和天然氣產品，當伊朗戰事導致全球能源供應緊張時，該地區的能源安全尤為脆弱。如果東南亞不加速進行結構性改革，到2035年，該地區用於能源進口的費用將上漲至2450億美元，約為2024年的3倍。報告說，對於東南亞地區現有能源系統來說，伊朗戰事既是“壓力測試”，也是推動結構性變革的“催化劑”。一些東南亞國家已採取措施，應對能源供應緊張。在菲律賓，政府宣佈全國進入能源緊急狀態，越來越多消費者開始在屋頂安裝太陽能電池板，以應對日漸上漲的能源支出。寮國鼓勵消費者駕駛電動車，並在5月下令今年停止進口燃油汽車。國際能源署建議東南亞各國加大投資各種可再生能源，並提高電網效率。 （央視財經）

【瑞銀：美伊停火協議有望推動油價回落，預期中資航空股盈利逐季改善】瑞銀髮表研報指，美國與伊朗達成停火協議，導致原油價格跌破每桶90美元。該行認為，雖然停火協議的簽署未必會引發油價在短期內立即崩塌至衝突前的水平，但這為油價持續下行趨勢提供了更為樂觀的前景。瑞銀指，雖然中資航空公司過去數月因油價上漲而受壓，股價表現疲弱，但市場已基本消化相關利空因素，下行空間有限。隨著未來潛在的燃油附加費下調有望刺激需求，該行預期中資航空公司將錄得連續按季改善，且季度利潤按年比較將迎來好轉。

【北京：支援企業採購並消費詞元（Token）開展人工智慧應用】北京市經濟和資訊化局印發《北京市關於支援工業企業提質增效若干措施》，其中提出，推動企業智慧化升級。引導工業企業與工業網際網路平臺企業、人工智慧模型企業深化合作，推動企業加快平臺化設計、智慧化生產、網路化協同、數字化管理等應用模式變革。針對企業在算力獲取、應用落地和能力提升中的難點，著力最佳化算力資源部署，豐富算力服務普惠供給。支援企業採購並消費詞元（Token）開展人工智慧應用，對符合條件的企業，根據其實際使用Token情況給予資金支援。

【駭客竊取丹麥藥企資料 勒索不成威脅“出售”】一個網路勒索團體16日聲稱，它從丹麥製藥巨頭諾和諾德公司竊取了超過1TB（太位元組）的資料，因對方拒絕支付2500萬美元贖金，目前正考慮出售部分資料。這個名為FulcrumSec的網路勒索團體在其網站發文稱，該團體潛伏諾和諾德公司內部網路2個多月，竊取了總計約1.3TB的資料，涉及企業原始碼、已上市及在研藥物的獨家核心資料、臨床試驗資料、員工資訊、醫生與患者個人資訊、工廠生產設施相關檔案以及人工智慧模型內部資料。（新華社）

European Stocks Set for Lower Open — European equity markets were poised for a weaker open on Wednesday as investors awaited further details on the US-Iran peace agreement while remaining cautious ahead of the Federal Reserve’s policy decision. The interim accord is scheduled to be signed in Switzerland on Friday and could unlock billions of dollars in frozen Iranian assets while allowing Tehran to immediately resume oil exports. Meanwhile, the Federal Reserve is widely expected to leave interest rates unchanged, with market participants closely watching the policy statement and updated economic projections for signals on the future path of monetary policy. In Europe, attention will also turn to UK inflation data ahead of this week's Bank of England meeting, where policymakers are broadly expected to keep rates unchanged. In premarket trading, futures linked to the Euro Stoxx 50 and Stoxx 600 were both lower by around 0.1%.

【UK May CPI unexpectedly unchanged at 2.8% YoY】ONS said May CPI rose 2.8% YoY, unchanged from April and below economists' 3.0% forecast. Food and non‑alcoholic beverages weighed on the headline, while services inflation — the domestic price‑pressure gauge — rose to 3.7%, above expectations. The data indicate inflationary pressures were smaller than expected even before a US deal to end the Iran conflict pushed energy costs sharply lower. The prints appear to reinforce a wait‑and‑see leaning among some Bank of England policymakers ahead of tomorrow's rate decision.

【機構前瞻美聯儲SEP和點陣圖變化】
1. 瑞銀：預計美聯儲將上調通脹預測，多數委員認為2028年前不宜降息，點陣圖中值或顯示2028年將有一次降息，但政策立場仍將保持緊縮。
2. 高盛：沃什可能不會提交個人點陣圖預測。點陣圖中值料顯示2026年利率維持不變，最終預測仍為2027年與2028年各降息一次。2026年的經濟預測可能顯示GDP增長率和失業率微降、通脹大幅上修。
3. 巴克萊：最新點陣圖或反映出更高的通脹預期和更謹慎的政策立場，即2026年全年維持利率不變、2027年僅降息一次、2028年繼續按兵不動。
4. 傑富瑞：沃什在參議院聽證會上就明確表示不認同前瞻性指引。這將成為最大變化，具體表現為FOMC宣告篇幅縮短，以及SEP細節減少。
5. 凱投宏觀：預計沃什不會提出自己的利率預測，但在新聞釋出會上仍會被問及他的看法。
6. 摩根大通：預計沃什將會提交其個人預測，否則將顯得如同對他自己所領導的委員會表達出一種立場鮮明的異議。
7. 道明證券：預計沃什將不提交個人點陣圖預測 ，以此作為策略性舉措，最大限度淡化6月點陣圖可能釋放的鷹派訊號。
8. 美國銀行：預計沃什將不提交個人預測，因其不相信前瞻指引。經濟增長預測或將下調至2.1%，通脹將被明顯上調，失業率預測可能小幅下調或維持不變。
9. 荷蘭合作銀行：預計風險偏向於通脹更頑固、降息更少甚至進行加息，而不是迅速好轉。樂觀預期已經落空。
10. 北歐聯合銀行：預計點陣圖將不會再包含3月份時曾預期的年內降息情境，甚至可能逐出現一些加息的呼聲。
11. 紐約梅隆銀行：預計點陣圖將出現略微偏鷹派的調整，預測中值極有可能取消此前對2026年底前降息一次的預測。
12. 太平洋投資管理公司：預計點陣圖將出現向鷹派方向的顯著偏移。預計2026年將出現幾次加息預測，但中位數仍顯示將維持不變。

【China-US shipping routes fully booked; container space scarce】CUSTOMS data show China’s goods exports in dollar terms rose 19.4% YoY in May, the fastest pace in three months. At a Ningbo freight forwarder, staff are repeatedly refreshing carriers’ booking systems; US routes account for about 70% of the firm’s volume. Firms report China-US sailings have been fully booked since May, with space tight across East and South China and intense competition for slots and empty containers. Freight rates for a 40ft box from Ningbo have jumped from roughly $2,900 to the US West and $3,900 to the US East at end‑April to about $6,300 and $7,500 respectively after several rounds of increases.

【分析師：寶馬釋出利潤預警後股價料將大幅走低】加皇資本市場分析師Tom Narayan寫道，在寶馬下調預期並警告稱業務好轉的可見度有限之後，預計該汽車製造商的股價今晨將大幅走低。他補充說，雖然寶馬正在擴大其成本削減計劃，但相關的重組費用將在下半年帶來額外的一次性不利因素。

【中美航線全面爆艙 中美航線一艙難求】海關總署資料顯示，以美元計，今年5月份，中國貨物貿易出口金額同比增長19.4%，創下近三個月以來的最高增速。在浙江寧波一家國際貨運代理企業，工作人員正不斷重新整理著船公司的訂艙系統，緊盯最新的放艙資訊。企業負責人告訴記者，美國航線的業務佔到他們總業務的七成。近期，搶艙位、搶空箱成了他們每天最重要的工作。企業負責人表示：“到了5月份之後，中美航線已經全面爆艙，華東、華南艙位全線緊張，整體回到了旺季緊缺的行情。”記者瞭解到，4月底，寧波到美國西部港口一個40英尺集裝箱的運價約為2900美元，到美國東部港口約為3900美元；經過數輪漲價，目前美西航線運價已接近6300美元，美東航線運價接近7500美元。（央視財經）

【分析師：印尼料將保留MSCI明晟新興市場地位】大華繼顯印尼研究團隊在一份報告中表示，在全球指數提供商MSCI明晟定於6月進行的即將到來的評估中，印尼可能會保留其新興市場地位。1月下旬，MSCI明晟指出了可投資性問題，這可能導致印尼被重新分類為“前沿市場”，比其現有地位低一個級別。儘管印尼證券交易所一直在進行改革以提高透明度和自由流通量，但MSCI明晟仍可能繼續監測市場可及性。有利的評估也將成為重新激發外國投資者興趣的近期催化劑，並對印尼市場產生提振作用。

【Preview: institutions expect Fed SEP/dot plot to tilt hawkish — Waller’s personal dot-plot status key】UBS, Goldman, Barclays, PIMCO and other institutions expect the Fed’s SEP/dot plot to show higher inflation and a more cautious policy path, pushing rate cuts later or reducing the number of cuts implied earlier this year. UBS: expects inflation forecasts to be revised up; most FOMC members see no rate cuts before 2028, though the median could still show a single 2028 cut while overall policy remains restrictive. Goldman: says Waller may not submit a personal dot plot; expects the median to show rates unchanged through 2026 with one cut in 2027 and another in 2028, and anticipates 2026 GDP and unemployment slightly lower but inflation materially higher. Barclays: expects a hawkish tilt — rates held all of 2026, only one cut in 2027, and no easing in 2028. Jefferies: flags Waller’s rejection of forward guidance as likely, implying a shorter FOMC statement and reduced SEP detail. Capital Economics: expects Waller will decline to provide a personal policy path but will still be pressed on his views at the press conference. JP Morgan: expects Waller to submit a personal forecast; not doing so would signal clear dissent from his committee leadership. TD Securities and BofA: anticipate Waller will not submit a personal dot plot; BofA expects growth forecasts to be trimmed to ~2.1% while inflation is revised up and unemployment is unchanged or slightly lower. Rabobank: sees risk skewed toward stickier inflation, fewer cuts or even upside to rates rather than a quick improvement. Nordea: expects removal of the intra-year cut scenario priced in March and even some calls for hikes. BNY Mellon: expects a modestly hawkish adjustment, likely dropping the previous expectation of a 2026 cut. PIMCO: expects a significant hawkish shift in the dot plot; several committee members may show projections for higher 2026 rates even if the median remains unchanged.

【機構：美聯儲本月的會議正被視為年內最重要的會議之一】儘管投資者對美聯儲將聯邦基金利率目標區間維持在3.50%–3.75%的決定毫無疑問，但法國外貿銀行的分析師Mabrouk Chetouane在一份報告中指出，此次貨幣政策會議仍是今年最重要的會議之一。“自上任以來，凱文·沃什作為FOMC主席出席的首場會議，將面臨艱鉅的任務，”這位全球市場策略主管表示。他指出，這位新任美聯儲主席不僅需要評估經濟形勢，還可能推動變革，特別是在央行溝通策略方面。“他上任後的首項舉措及其初期表態將受到密切關注，因為在這個全球最具影響力的貨幣機構中，過渡期通常會給資本市場帶來壓力。”

【高盛：首予零跑汽車“買入”評級及目標價50港元】高盛發表研報，首予零跑汽車“買入”評級，12個月目標價為50港元，預期公司在未來三個季度推出的具競爭力新車型將推動內地市場增長加速。該行指出，零跑汽車2026年海外目標銷量為12.5萬輛，而該行預計其海外銷量有60%的上行空間，這使該行對公司2026年至2028年的淨利潤預測較市場共識高出7%至12%。該行預測，零跑汽車在2025年至2027年將實現行業領先的48%收入複合年增長率和143%的盈利複合年增長率。

【WeChat Pay launches AI-specific card】WeChat Pay has launched an AI-specific card that lets users submit purchase requests within an Agent chat; it handles smart recommendations through order placement and payment. The card is currently supported in WorkBuddy.

【Institution: This month’s Fed meeting is being viewed as one of the year’s most important】Investors widely expect the Fed to hold the federal funds target range at 3.50%–3.75% at this month’s meeting, but Natixis global markets strategist Mabrouk Chetouane says the meeting remains one of the year’s most important. He notes this will be Kevin Walsh’s first FOMC meeting as chair and that Walsh faces a difficult task: assessing the economy and possibly driving change, particularly in the Fed’s communication strategy. Chetouane says Walsh’s initial actions and early remarks will be closely watched, since leadership transitions at the world’s most influential central bank often create pressure on capital markets.

UK Inflation Surprisingly Holds at 2.8% — The annual inflation rate in the UK stood at 2.8% in May 2026, unchanged from the previous month and below market expectations of 3.0%. The reading remained at its lowest level since March last year. Inflation slowed in housing and household services (2.7% vs. 3.0% in April), the softest level in almost two years, as owner-occupiers’ housing costs continued to ease, while food and non-alcoholic beverages decelerated further (2.2% vs. 3.0%), hitting their lowest level since December 2024. Price growth also moderated in clothing and footwear (0.2% vs. 0.7%) and recreation and culture (1.5% vs. 1.7%). This was offset by upward pressure from transport inflation, which accelerated sharply to 6.8%, the highest since December 2022, up from 4.5% in April, driven by higher motor fuel prices, rising air fares, and an upward effect from vehicle excise duty (VED). On a monthly basis, the CPI rose by 0.2% in May, below forecasts of a 0.4% gain and easing from a 0.7% increase in April.

UK Core Inflation Slightly Below Estimates — The UK's annual core inflation rate edged up to 2.6% in May 2026 from April's nearly five-year low of 2.5%, though it came in slightly below market expectations of 2.7%. Core goods inflation eased to 2.0% from 2.4%, while core services inflation accelerated to 3.7% from 3.2%. On a monthly basis, core consumer prices rose 0.3%, slowing from a 0.7% increase in April and falling short of forecasts of 0.4%. It also marked the softest monthly rise since January.

【UK May CPI unexpectedly unchanged at 2.8%】UK May CPI held at 2.8% YoY, matching April and below economists' 3.0% forecast, in data released Wednesday one day before the Bank of England's policy decision. Inflation remains roughly 1 percentage point above the BoE's January projection; in April the Bank warned headline CPI could exceed 3.5% by year-end and, in the three worst-case scenarios, top 6% in early next year. Markets were relieved this week by an apparent US-Iran agreement that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz; the UK, as a major importer of gas, is more exposed to the conflict than most Western peers. Economists expect the BoE MPC to hold Bank Rate at 3.75% this month by a 7-2 vote.

UK Producer Inflation Matches Forecasts in May — Factory gate prices for UK-manufactured goods advanced 4.0% year-on-year in May 2026, in line with market expectations but slightly easing from an upwardly revised 4.1% rise in April, which was the highest reading since May 2023. Almost all 10 product groups made upward contributions to the annual rate, led by a surge in prices of coke and refined petroleum products (55.6% vs 51.1% in April) amid higher energy costs. Inflation also accelerated for other outputs from manufacturing (4.3% vs 3.1% in April) and basic metals, fabricated metal products and machinery (4.2% vs 4.1%). Meanwhile, motor vehicles and other transport equipment provided the largest downward contribution, with prices falling 1.7% (vs 2.2% in April). The decline was due to supply chain issues and other market factors. Monthly, factory gate prices rose 0.5%, slowing from an upwardly revised 1.5% increase in April, matching market forecasts and marking the softest increase since February, when producer prices fell.

【中國證監會：支援港股上市公司境內上市 推進人民幣外匯期貨試點】今天，2026年陸家嘴論壇在上海開幕，本屆論壇主題為“全球治理倡議下的金融發展與合作：新願景、新挑戰和新機遇”。在本次論壇上，中國證監會主席吳清提出多項舉措。

鼓勵外資市場機構參與基金投顧等業務

具體舉措包括：支援符合條件的港股上市公司境內上市，更好促進兩地市場聯動發展；加快研究推進人民幣外匯期貨試點，以應對匯率波動風險、支援企業國際化發展；支援香港於近期啟動5年期人民幣國債期貨上市交易，不斷提升外資長期配置中國資產的便利化水平，以及支援外資金融機構來華展業等。

吳清表示，還應積極支援外資在華新設投資或者合資的證券、基金、期貨機構，鼓勵外資市場機構參與基金投顧，擴大試點等等，更好促進在華展業興業。

大力支援上市公司併購及再融資

吳清表示，將進一步激發併購重組活力，用好用足併購重組快速稽核機制，積極打通併購實施過程中的堵點卡點，推動最佳化併購相關政策，降低交易成本。

今年在二月初，滬深北交易所都發布實施了最佳化再融資的一攬子措施。突出扶優扶科的導向，一些優質上市公司高效實現融資稽核用時。將抓緊修訂《上市公司證券發行政策的管理辦法》等制度規則，加快推出儲架發行等機制，進一步提升公司再融資的靈活性、便利度。

將持續豐富資本市場各類投資產品和工具

其中包括：支援在滬深交易所推出主動ETF；推出商業不動產REITs試點，4單首批專案18日將在上交所掛牌上市；推出支援中小基金公司規範健康發展的一攬子措施，支援中小基金公司差異化發展。

吳清表示，包括堅持分類監管，突出特色，在產品佈局與業務准入等方面給予適當的傾斜。積極支援中小基金的差異化發展。持續提升監管效能和適應性。在增強制度包容性，提高市場含客量的同時，還將不斷提升監管科技化、智慧化的水平。

依法打擊各類跨境違法違規經營行為

持牌經營是金融監管的基本要求，也是對金融產品消費者有效保護的基本要求。中國證監會將進一步推動健全跨境監管協調機制，切實維護市場正常秩序。

近期，中國證監會會同有關部門堅決查處了個別機構違法違規的跨境展業問題，受到國內國際高度關注。

吳清表示，將堅持開正門、堵偏門，既支援合法合規的跨境投融資活動，又依法打擊各類跨境違法行為。（央視新聞）

Kyrgyzstan Inflation Eases Slightly in May — The annual inflation rate in Kyrgyzstan eased slightly to 11.0% in May 2026 from 11.4% in the previous month, which had marked a near three-year high. Price pressures moderated in food and non-alcoholic beverages (9.8% vs 10.8% in April), housing and utilities (9.7% vs 12.7%), healthcare (11.4% vs 12.0%), recreation and culture (11.5% vs 11.7%), education (22.3% vs 22.4%), and miscellaneous goods and services (20.9% vs 20.4%). Meanwhile, inflation accelerated for alcoholic beverages and tobacco (11.7% vs 10.9%), clothing and footwear (7.1% vs 6.5%), household goods and appliances (9.3% vs 8.6%), and transport (11.8% vs 10.2%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices edged up 0.8% in May, following a 0.7% increase in the previous month.

【PBOC governor Pan to narrow temporary overnight repo band, expand overnight reverse repos】At the Lujiazui Forum on June 17, PBOC governor Pan Gongsheng said the central bank will narrow the temporary overnight repo rate corridor from 70bps to a symmetric 50bps and will add overnight reverse-repo instruments as needed. Pan said the PBOC will move the timing of temporary repo operations earlier and disclosed trigger conditions: DR001 persistently below or above the corresponding temporary repo operation rate would activate the tool to better anchor market expectations. The measures are presented as accelerating the shift to a price-based monetary framework to strengthen transmission from policy rates to market rates. DR001 has traded about ±20bps around policy rates this year; the PBOC said specific overnight reverse-repo operational details will be set by market demand and implemented progressively.

【專家解讀兩大舉措完善短端利率調控機制】中國人民銀行行長潘功勝6月17日在2026陸家嘴論壇上提出，完善短端利率調控機制的兩項舉措，一是將臨時隔夜正/逆回購的操作利率區間由此前的70bp收窄為對稱的50bp；二是將適時增加公開市場隔夜逆回購操作品種。專家表示，這是持續推動貨幣政策框架向價格型轉型，使政策利率向市場利率傳導不斷增強的重要舉措。今年以來，隔夜利率DR001基本在政策利率上下20bp的區間執行，央行順勢收窄臨時回購利率區間，也體現了穩中求進的總體原則。上述專家表示，央行此次還將臨時回購的操作時間適當提前，並披露了工具的觸發條件，即DR001持續低於或高於臨時回購相應操作利率，能更好穩定市場預期。專家表示，此次央行宣佈將適時增加隔夜逆回購品種，既是順應市場需求，也有利於增強短端利率調控的精準性和有效性。隔夜逆回購的具體操作安排將結合市場需求確定，也體現了循序漸進的改革思路。（中證金牛座）

PBoC Moves to Strengthen Rate Framework — The People's Bank of China announced on Wednesday several measures to improve its short-term interest rate framework, signaling a possible shift toward using the overnight policy rate as its main benchmark instead of the current seven-day reverse repo rate. Governor Pan Gongsheng said the central bank will narrow the interest rate corridor for its temporary overnight repo and reverse repo facilities while increasing overnight reverse repo operations. He said further that the central bank is developing tools to provide emergency liquidity to non-bank financial institutions during times of market stress. Chinese authorities also rolled out new measures to promote the yuan's international use, including a repo facility allowing foreign monetary authorities and sovereign wealth funds to access yuan liquidity using bonds as collateral, alongside a pilot program for offshore yuan foreign exchange trading in the Shanghai Free Trade Zone.

【Institution forecasts for Fed rate path: pause expected; views diverge on timing of cuts and upside risk】Most institutions expect the Fed to hold at the upcoming meeting and to remove dovish forward guidance; views diverge on timing and direction of the next move. MOODY'S: hold; cuts unlikely short-term, baseline no cut this year; could hike if inflation expectations rise. Nomura: hold; near-term cuts unlikely, possibly unchanged through 2026. JP Morgan: hold; rates to remain unchanged for the rest of the year, policy shifting from easing toward neutral. Wells Fargo: hold; would only hike if clear labour-market overheating or worse inflation. BNY MELLON: hold; statement likely to signal two-way risks and drop 2026 cut expectations; no moves this year. Goldman Sachs: hold; expects removal of easing guidance and two 25bp cuts in Jun and Dec 2027. UBS: hold; expects abandonment of dovish wording and 25bp cuts in Mar and Jun 2027. CITIGROUP: hold; expects three 25bp cuts in Sep, Oct and Dec. Commerzbank: hold; may begin cuts mid-next year, cumulative -75bp by end-2027. Capital Economics: hold but sees high probability of two “insurance” hikes in Dec and early next year. BNP Paribas: hold; little chance of pre-midterm hike, earliest hike in Dec, pace milder than 2022. Deutsche Bank: hold; baseline unchanged long-term but upside risk rising. PGIM: hold; expects three hikes this year, then three cuts in 2027 and one in 2028, terminal rate ~3.375%. Barclays, BofA, ANZ and Mitsubishi UFJ: expect hold and likely deletion of dovish phrasing; BofA may adjust employment wording and ANZ expects reaffirmed 2% inflation commitment. MFS: hold; may signal a neutral stance and consider dropping the dot-plot and reducing press-conference time.

【超110股已連跌5年 機構關注度較高個股梳理】AI產業鏈狂飆突進，創業板和科創50指數近期更是創出歷史新高。不過，近年來市場分化較為劇烈，部分個股股價連年下挫，甚至出現連跌幾年的情況。據資料寶統計，有超110只個股股價已經連跌5年（包含今年以來漲跌幅）。從連跌年數來看，兩隻影視股儒意電影、ST華誼均連跌11年，金隅股份、金融街、金隅冀東等個股均連跌7年。從累計跌幅來看，退市岩石跌幅最大，累計下跌接近94%；中公教育跌幅位居次席，跌超94%。此外，堅朗五金、ST華誼等個股累計跌幅均超90%，儒意電影、康泰生物、萬科A、ST龍大等個股累計跌幅均超80%。從市值來看，仍有4只個股A股市值超千億元，分別是邁瑞醫療、山西汾酒、金龍魚和瀘州老窖。機構關注度較高的個股中，據資料寶統計，山西汾酒、邁瑞醫療、瀘州老窖、捨得酒業等20多股有10家及以上機構評級，儒意電影、志邦家居、晶澳科技等16股有5—9家機構評級。機構關注度最高的是山西汾酒，有33家機構評級。國信證券表示，短期看，2026年客觀上仍存在場景和需求壓力，渠道庫存處於較高水平，全年公司將逐步釋放經營壓力，收入及淨利潤預計下滑。中長期看，清香勢能向上，公司產品品價比突出，管理提質增效，全國化及高階化仍有空間。（證券時報）

【勒令伊朗國足連夜離境 美方辯稱“本應如此”】伊朗國家足球隊在美國洛杉磯結束世界盃首戰後被美方勒令“立即離開美國、返回墨西哥駐地”。伊朗隊就此指責美方出爾反爾，而白宮分管本屆世界盃事務的官員16日辯稱，原定計劃就是這樣。白宮國際足聯工作組執行總監安德魯·朱利亞尼告訴美聯社：“我們事先已表明，流程就是這麼定的。”在採訪中，朱利亞尼證實美方拒絕伊朗隊部分後勤人員和官員入境申請，但不肯作出具體說明，只說美國務卿魯比奧先前已表明，“任何與伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊有直接關聯的人員都不能進入美國”。（新華社）
【公司和長鑫科技是否有合作？藍箭電子回應】有投資者向藍箭電子提問，貴公司和長鑫科技有合作嗎？是貴公司的客戶嗎？ 6月17日，公司回答表示，公司與長鑫科技暫無業務合作，所有資訊請以公司在指定資訊披露媒體披露的公告為準。(財聞)

【機構：私募信貸領域的軟體違約很大程度上被視為成長的煩惱】英仕曼集團在其下半年信貸展望報告中表示，私募信貸領域備受關注的軟體違約很大程度上被視為該行業的成長的煩惱，而不是像一些人所描繪的那樣，是該資產類別走向終結的開始。這家投資管理公司認為，信貸質量和嚴格的管理人選擇對於私募信貸仍將至關重要。英仕曼集團表示，私募信貸行業可能必須區分部署人工智慧(AI)以增強和鞏固其競爭地位的軟體公司，與那些核心產品正被人工智慧(AI)取代的軟體公司。該機構補充道：“具有深度客戶整合、高轉換成本和強定價能力的關鍵任務企業軟體，與單點解決方案、商品化的[軟體即服務]產品，是截然不同的信貸主張。”

【Refined fuel retail prices likely to record first back-to-back decline this year】Easing Middle East tensions and an imminent peace agreement have driven crude sharply lower, deepening its negative adjustment. Zhuochuang Info calculates the oil adjustment rate at -10.72% at the close on June 16 (ninth working day), implying a roughly 475 yuan/ton cut to gasoline and diesel. With one trading day before the pricing window, a large retail fuel price reduction at 24:00 on June 18 is likely and the final cut could exceed 500 yuan/ton. If implemented, this would be the first consecutive retail price decline in China this year.

【韓國央行預計通脹將持續高於目標水平 直至明年】韓國央行週三表示，儘管美伊結束戰爭的談判取得進展，但由於價格上漲壓力仍然較大，通脹預計將持續高於其目標水平直至明年。韓國央行表示：“展望未來，通脹預計將在相當長的一段時間內保持高位。儘管隨著戰爭局勢的緩和，油價將逐漸下降，但高油價和匯率帶來的成本上漲壓力預計將傳導至其他產品。”韓國央行在其半年一次的通脹目標政策報告中表示，由於工資上漲（例如一些科技公司發放鉅額獎金）帶來的日益增長的需求側壓力，今年下半年消費者通脹率將保持在3%左右，明年將繼續超過央行2%的中期目標。央行的展望進一步強化了最早於下個月收緊貨幣政策的理由。受中東衝突導致油價上漲的影響，5月消費者通脹率升至兩年多來新高3.1%。

【印尼60億元訂單在深圳龍崗釋出】6月15日下午，“廣東—印尼AI+醫療+新能源產業交流合作活動”在龍崗區企業國際化服務基地舉辦。作為APEC“中國年”背景下的精準對接會，本次活動釋放了印尼方49個採購訂單，總金額高達60億元。活動當天，廣東省對印尼貿易促進會深圳辦事處正式落戶龍崗區企業國際化服務基地。活動現場，印尼方一次性發布49個採購訂單，涵蓋安防、能源、礦業、漁業、醫療等領域。其中，由龍崗企業自主研發專利的電煙灶產品前期訂單量5萬臺，後續長期訂單有望增至500萬臺，對應規模約40億元。深圳星焰電火科技有限公司、深圳市八方通達科技有限公司、中環興業（深圳）實業有限公司3家企業現場簽署合作備忘錄。

【遼寧：引導金融機構創新產品和服務 積極支援優質企業上市】據遼寧日報，6月17日，全省服務業大會在瀋陽召開。遼寧省委書記許昆林出席會議並講話。許昆林強調，生產性服務業是產業延鏈增值的關鍵支撐，要深入挖掘潛力，著力提高生產性服務業發展能級。堅持向“專”深耕、促進供需高效適配，推動研發設計、檢驗檢測認證、智慧財產權等業態專業化、定製化、精細化發展，引導大型工業企業外包專業服務業務，加強撮合對接，推動生產性服務業更好嵌入製造業價值鏈各環節。堅持向“高”而進、推動價值鏈延伸，做強現代物流，完善現代化綜合交通運輸體系，加強水網、路網等建設，加快推進內河復航，培育智慧物流等新業態；做優金融服務，大力發展期貨、基金、融資租賃，引導金融機構創新產品和服務，積極支援優質企業上市；壯大科技服務，健全技術轉移轉化服務體系，加快發展軟體、租賃和商務服務業，推動生產性服務業全鏈條升級。

【機構：日本央行的加息理由標誌著政策邏輯的轉向】索尼金融集團經濟學家Tetsuya Inoue表示，日本央行決定將通脹上行風險作為加息理由，這標誌著其政策邏輯出現了明顯的轉向。這一轉變與先前的加息形成鮮明對比，當時該央行強調調整貨幣政策是為了以穩定和可持續的方式實現其2%的通脹目標。Inoue表示，如果該央行在採取政策行動方面落後於形勢，可能會引發長期債券收益率激增，進一步削弱日元，並加速通脹。
【芯生視界近日完成近億元人民幣種子輪融資】侵入式腦機介面公司芯生視界近日完成近億元人民幣種子輪融資。本輪融資由經緯創投領投，星連資本、燕緣創投、水木創投跟投。

【阿聯酋富查伊拉5月船用燃油銷量創歷史新低】標普全球釋出的富查伊拉石油工業區最新資料顯示，受中東戰事影響霍爾木茲海峽航運受阻、船舶補給需求持續低迷，阿聯酋富查伊拉港5月船用燃油銷量持續下滑，創下歷史新低。不含潤滑油的船用燃油5月總銷量為96721立方米（約95800噸）。低硫船用燃油銷量環比下降27%，至65120立方米。高硫船用燃油銷量環比下滑15%，達31601立方米。低硫船用瓦斯油銷量微降2%，為7157立方米，其餘品類船用瓦斯油銷量合計381立方米。5月低硫船燃市場佔比由4月的71%降至67%；高硫船燃佔比由29%升至33%。
【日本國債期貨走高  10年期日本國債收益率下跌5.0個基點 】日本國債期貨走高，追隨隔夜美國國債市場的價格漲勢。日本國債價格可能也受到週二原油價格下跌的提振，這緩解了日本的通脹壓力。10年期日本國債收益率下跌5.0個基點，至2.595%。

【北京：前5月全市市場總消費額同比增長1.5%】北京市統計局釋出2026年1-5月北京經濟執行情況。1-5月，全市市場總消費額同比增長1.5%。其中，服務性消費額增長4.5%，資訊、交通等領域較快增長；實現社會消費品零售總額5469億元，下降2.5%。社會消費品零售總額中，按消費形態分，商品零售4942.7億元，下降2.8%；餐飲收入526.3億元，增長0.8%。從商品類別看，限額以上批發和零售業中，金銀珠寶類商品零售額增長23.3%，受金價下行影響增速回落；新能源汽車類商品零售額增長4.1%，智慧手錶等可穿戴智慧裝置類、高能效等級家用電器和音像器材類商品零售額均增長5成以上；與基本生活相關的飲料類、菸酒類商品零售額分別增長4.1%和11.1%；受傳統燃油車需求不足影響，汽車類商品零售額下降17.3%。（第一財經）

【快手：持續打擊劇情演繹黑灰產，配合有關部門抓獲34名犯罪嫌疑人】近日，快手安全中心在直播治理中發現，一些不法分子虛構富豪、法師、高官等人設，以劇情演繹方式向中老年使用者高價售賣低價值商品，並承諾高價回收，誘騙中老年使用者下單購買，實施詐騙行為。對此，快手安全中心不斷升級風控策略，提升違規線索識別、研判和處置能力，嚴肅處理違規內容及賬號，針對查實詐騙線索，依法固定證據並移交有關部門處理。今年以來，快手安全中心協助有關部門抓獲劇情演繹詐騙犯罪嫌疑人共34名。（快手黑板報）

South Korean Won Halts Gains — The South Korean won weakened to around 1,515 per dollar, ending its recent advance, as demand for the greenback firmed amid cautious positioning ahead of the Federal Reserve’s policy decision. Market participants focused on potential signals from the FOMC under Fed Chair Kevin Warsh regarding the future policy path, with uncertainty over the outlook keeping FX markets defensive. Broader risk-off sentiment, driven by weakness in global technology stocks and declines in US AI-related shares, supported safe-haven flows into the dollar and weighed on Asian currencies. The won also came under pressure from ongoing portfolio rebalancing flows and softer regional risk appetite. Meanwhile, expectations that the Bank of Korea will maintain a relatively tight policy stance helped limit the pace of losses. Authorities’ continued monitoring of foreign exchange volatility also provided some support, preventing sharper depreciation.

【Qatar reroutes LNG carriers to Middle East as Strait of Hormuz poised to reopen】Following a US-Iran deal that has the Strait of Hormuz poised to reopen, Qatar has begun repositioning LNG carriers to the Middle East to prepare for higher exports. Vessel-tracking shows at least four Qatar-owned empty LNG carriers that were idle or diverted are now turning back toward the region, with Ras Laffan listed as their next port; a Qatar-chartered ship is also en route. Separately, four Qatar-linked tankers are anchored in the Gulf of Oman and may attempt transit through Hormuz into the Persian Gulf. Qatar has not sent empty ships into the Gulf since the February outbreak of war. The moves account for only a small portion of Qatar’s roughly 70-vessel fleet but signal readiness to lift shipments if the strait reopens.

【全球主動ETF加速擴容 資產規模達2.33萬億美元】據ETFGI資料顯示，截至2026年4月底，全球主動管理ETF資產規模已達到2.33萬億美元，創下歷史新高，2026年以來淨流入達3116.6億美元，同樣重新整理同期最高紀錄。

Rupiah Steady as Markets Await BI, Fed Rate Decisions — The Indonesian rupiah hovered around IDR 17,750 per U.S. dollar on Wednesday, little changed from the prior session as traders awaited the central bank's interest rate decision Thursday. Bank Indonesia began its two-day policy meeting today and is widely expected to maintain its tightening bias after delivering a total of 75bps in rate hikes since May. While tighter monetary policy should help anchor inflation expectations and support the rupiah, elevated borrowing costs could gradually weigh on domestic demand. On the fiscal front, local media said that the government has cut the budget for its flagship Free Meal Program by an estimated Rp67 trillion as President Prabowo seeks broader spending efficiency. Jakarta also reaffirmed that subsidized fuel and LPG prices will remain unchanged. Globally, the U.S. dollar index was steady as markets awaited the Fed's policy decision, where interest rates are widely expected to remain unchanged at the first meeting chaired by Kevin Warsh.

【Active ETFs broaden onshore public fund lineup; domestic ETF market near CNY5 tln】China’s onshore ETF market AUM is approaching CNY5 tln, and improving fund-manager capabilities and investor sophistication create favorable conditions for launching active ETFs. Globally, ETFs total USD19.9 tln as of end‑March; passive ETFs USD17.8 tln (89.4%), active ETFs USD2.1 tln (10.6%). Active ETFs have posted a 10‑year CAGR of 44% versus 19% for total ETFs. Institutional adoption is rising as more professional managers include active ETFs in asset allocations.

【韓國5月汽車出口、內銷和產量同比齊降，新能源汽車表現穩健】5月韓國汽車出口額58.3億美元，同比減少5.9%。出口量為230072輛，同比減少6.6%。本土銷量（127315輛）和產量（329559輛）同比分減10.3%和8.2%。儘管如此，新能源汽車產銷增長勢頭依然強勁。5月新能源汽車出口額為24億美元，同比增加9.9%，佔汽車總出口的40%以上。出口量為83145輛，同比增加11.2%。本土銷量為77179輛，同比增加5.5%。
【法拉第未來發布四款機器人 構建“一腦多形”戰略】6月17日，在納斯達克上市的法拉第未來舉辦六大系列“全形態FFEAI機器人世界”上半場——六大系列全形態FFEAI機器人世界&EAI教育生態及產品線釋出會，正式釋出全新Futurist（2027款）人形機器人與FXNavi四足機器人，以及FFMasterMini與FFNova四款EAI機器人。

Sensex Extends Rally to Fourth Day — India’s BSE Sensex rose about 0.3% to 77,065 on Wednesday, extending gains for a fourth consecutive session, although investors became cautious as they awaited fresh catalysts ahead of the US Federal Reserve’s policy decision later in the day, while also monitoring the broader global economic outlook. Among stocks in focus, Infosys announced an artificial intelligence partnership with Valmet, while Wipro launched a new AI center. Reliance Industries remained in the spotlight amid reports of a potential $4 billion initial public offering for its Jio business. Early gainers included Car Trade (9.4%), MTAR (3.5%), Trent (3.2%), Tejas (3%), HSCL (2.6%), and Netweb (1.9%). Meanwhile, Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s “trust deficit” remarks ahead of his meeting with US President Donald Trump highlight underlying geopolitical tensions, though any market reaction will likely hinge on concrete policy outcomes, with investors watching trade, tariffs, and broader economic ties.

【油輪掉頭 駛往中東等候霍爾木茲海峽通航】本週，兩艘原本駛向非洲的油輪在印度洋掉頭，改航中東。船東們爭相調整船舶部署，趕在霍爾木茲海峽有望重新開放前搶佔運力。船舶追蹤資料顯示，蘇伊士型油輪 “卡波迪斯特里亞斯 21 號” （Kapodistrias 21）於週一大幅轉向，原定停靠加彭，下一港變更為阿聯酋富查伊拉港；超大型原油輪 “ Coslucky Lake” 原本前往南非，同日調整航線，目的地同樣改為富查伊拉。航線調整發生在美國與伊朗達成臨時和平協議數小時後。雙方在諒解備忘錄草案中承諾解除海上封鎖、重新開放海峽，該協議定於本週五正式簽署。這條全球關鍵水道承擔全球五分之一原油與液化天然氣運輸量，自 2 月末美以首輪打擊伊朗以來實際處於斷航狀態。多數船東仍持觀望態度，但部分風險承受能力更強的企業已著手敲定往返海峽的航次訂單。當前航運仍附帶風險溢價，率先行動的船東有望賺取更高運費。

【Clinton: Netanyahu sees war as political shield; US-Iran deal would be 'fatal blow'】Former US Secretary of State Hillary Clinton said Netanyahu views war as a political shield amid mounting domestic pressure, using conflict to suppress opponents and rally the nation. 【日本兩地發生食物中毒事件 百餘人出現症狀 】據日本媒體16日報道，日本廣島縣福山市和愛知縣名古屋市近日接連發生食物中毒事件，累計導致百餘人出現相關症狀。報道說，本月11日，在福山市一家住宿設施食用餐食的人中，97人出現腹瀉、腹痛症狀。當地保健所從部分患者體內檢出產氣莢膜梭菌，認定這是一起集體食物中毒事件，並對該住宿設施作出暫停營業處分。另一起事件發生在名古屋市會員制超市。5名7歲至49歲的男女食用該店製作銷售的捲餅類食品後出現腹痛、腹瀉等症狀，其中3人住院。住院患者中，一名小學生出現溶血性尿毒綜合徵。名古屋市已對製作涉事食品相關場所作出暫停營業處分。

【孚能科技與德國WLF Energy簽署戰略合作協議】據孚能科技訊息，近日，孚能科技與德國能源技術公司WLF Energy簽署戰略合作協議。根據協議，雙方將共同制定技術與產品路線圖，聯合開發面向公用事業、商業與工業以及分散式儲能市場的下一代電池技術和儲能產品。合作內容涵蓋電芯、電池系統、能源管理軟體、人工智慧以及大規模儲能解決方案的部署。雙方還將探索虛擬電廠、智慧能源基礎設施、可再生能源併網及電網穩定等應用場景，並共同制定面向未來十年的長期技術路線圖，評估和實施多種電池化學體系、先進電池管理技術及AI驅動的最佳化演算法，推動標準化產品架構的全球可擴充套件性。

Cape Verde Inflation Rate Rises from 2-Year Low — The annual inflation rate in Cape Verde rose to 0.8% in May 2026 from 0.3% in the previous month, which marked the lowest reading since March 2024. Upward pressure came mainly from transportation (3.4% vs 0.8% in April), alcoholic beverages and tobacco (3.9% vs 3.8%), and food and non-alcoholic beverages (0.8% vs 0.2%). Additionally, deflation eased in housing and utilities (-3.8% vs -4.2%). Meanwhile, price growth slowed in furnishings and household equipment (6.2% vs 6.7%), clothing and footwear (4.2% vs 4.7%), health (2.9% vs 3.1%), recreation and culture (1.3% vs 1.5%), education (0.2% vs 0.3%), hotels, restaurants and cafés (3.5% vs 3.9%), and miscellaneous goods and services (0.6% vs 1.3%), while communication costs declined (-0.3% vs 0.1%). On a monthly basis, the CPI rose 0.5%, following gains of 0.1% in each of the previous two months.

【Institution: BOJ successfully maintained market stability but yen remains in weak range】The BOJ’s policy decision kept financial markets relatively calm, but the yen remains near historic lows. On Tuesday USD/JPY’s intraday range was just 0.43 yen, the smallest on a BOJ meeting final day since Jan 2021. Wednesday morning USD/JPY was still above 160, close to the level that triggered late-April MOF intervention to support the yen. Investors are watching for further intervention after Finance Minister KATAYAMA said her team stands ready to act if needed. A Mitsubishi UFJ strategist said: "Given continued verbal intervention from MOF officials, many investors remain wary of actual intervention risk. Therefore we continue to expect USD/JPY to trade within a range."

【 何立峰出席2026陸家嘴論壇開幕式並講話 】 中共中央政治局委員、國務院副總理何立峰17日出席2026陸家嘴論壇開幕式並講話。中共中央政治局委員、上海市委書記陳吉寧出席活動。何立峰指出，近年來，中國在金融領域堅持防風險強監管促高質量發展的工作主線，推動金融事業不斷向前發展。當前百年變局正在加速演進，世界經濟發展和全球金融執行面臨考驗。中國將錨定中國特色金融發展之路不動搖、不偏航，全面落實“十五五”規劃綱要部署，服務經濟高質量發展，為世界經濟注入穩定力量。中國將繼續穩步擴大金融領域制度型開放，歡迎全球各國金融機構深耕中國市場，共享中國發展機遇。何立峰強調，面對全球發展和治理難題，唯有基於國際規則和多邊主義的相互尊重、和平共處、合作共贏才是正道。中國將不斷完善金融法治，堅定不移維護國家金融安全。中國願與各方一道，加強全球金融治理合作，攜手應對風險挑戰。何立峰指出，上海匯聚全球金融要素資源，作為國際金融中心的獨特優勢不斷顯現，將支援上海先行先試發展離岸金融，加快建設人民幣資產全球配置中心和風險管理中心，提升跨境貿易投資便利化水平，進一步豐富完善包括航運保險在內的信貸、保險、債券等產品體系，推動上海國際金融中心建設實現新的突破和提升。（新華社）

【CHINA'S HE at 2026 Lujiazui Forum urges offshore finance, RMB global-allocation push, tighter financial-security oversight】CHINA'S HE, a Politburo member and vice premier, told the opening of the 2026 Lujiazui Forum China will strengthen financial rule of law and resolutely safeguard national financial security, and is willing to deepen cooperation on global financial governance. He said Beijing will support Shanghai in piloting offshore finance, accelerate building a global RMB asset-allocation center and a risk-management center, enhance cross-border trade and investment facilitation, and broaden credit, insurance, bond and shipping-insurance product offerings to drive further upgrades to Shanghai’s international financial center.

【吳清：對投資者透過合法渠道進行跨境投資給予支援和保護】6月17日，證監會主席吳清在2026陸家嘴論壇上表示，近期國際國內都比較關注有關方面對跨境展業的整治，這裡面也有一些誤讀。吳清談到，近期證監會會同有關方面堅決查處了個別機構的違法違規跨境展業這樣的問題，接下來還會進一步推動健全跨境監管協調機制，強化日常資訊共享和市場溝通。開正門、堵偏門，既支援合法合規的跨境投融資活動，又依法打擊各類跨境違法行為。“沒有在境內持牌的機構在境內開展跨境證券交易服務，這是在任何地方都不能允許的，（整治）是針對這種未持牌機構的違法經營的行為，並不是整治投資者跨境投資。”吳清說。吳清指出，對投資者透過合法渠道的跨境投資，我們還是給予支援，也給予有效保護的。“沒有在境內持牌的機構在境內從事業務，不管是在境外持牌的機構，還是在境內設立的機構，沒持牌都是不能經營的，這是整個金融監管基本的要求，也是對投資者和金融產品消費者有效保護的基本要求。”吳清進一步指出，“所以我們要依法打擊的是這種各類的跨境違法、違規的經營行為，切實維護市場正常秩序，切實有效地保護投資者的合法權益。”

【Wu Qing: Support and protect investors' cross‑border investment via legal channels】June 17, 2026 — CSRC Chair Wu Qing said at the Lujiazui Forum that regulators have recently cracked down on individual firms conducting illegal cross‑border securities business and will further strengthen cross‑border supervisory coordination, routine information sharing and market communication. The policy intent is to open lawful cross‑border channels while blocking illegal ones; unlicensed entities providing cross‑border securities trading services domestically are the enforcement target, not investors who invest overseas through legal channels. Wu said investors using legitimate channels will be supported and effectively protected.

【Bank wealth managers quietly cleared for interbank FX and Bond Connect Southbound access】Chinese bank wealth management firms have been granted two market access approvals. On June 16 Bank of China Wealth Management completed the first interbank FX trade by a wealth manager via the China Foreign Exchange Trade System with Bank of China, executing USD/CHF spot and forward trades. Separately, three wealth managers received first-batch qualification to participate in Bond Connect Southbound; the inaugural Southbound transaction landed at the end of last month and was executed by CMB Wealth Management with Bank of Communications’ Hong Kong branch, which said it proactively coordinated and completed preparations after the participant expansion. Industry sources say the other two initial Bond Connect-qualified firms are wealth-management arms of two state-owned banks.
【陽光數科與螞蟻數科達成戰略合作，共建AI保險應用聯合實驗室】據陽光保險集團訊息，6月16日，陽光保險集團旗下陽光數智科技有限責任公司與螞蟻區塊鏈科技（上海）有限公司在北京正式簽署戰略合作協議。雙方將深度融合AI技術與保險業務洞察，打造覆蓋保險全流程的智慧化解決方案，共同探索保險行業數字化轉型的新路徑。

【銀行理財兩大業務資質低調開閘】銀行理財迎利好，近日兩大業務資質低調開閘。記者獲悉，銀行理財公司近日被首度引入銀行間外幣對市場，於6月16日完成理財資金在該市場的首筆交易；同時，三家理財公司已低調獲批首批債券通“南向通”參與主體資格，首筆交易於上月末落地。具體來看，銀行理財在銀行間外幣對市場的首筆交易由，由中銀理財依託外匯交易中心平臺與中國銀行達成，業務品種是美元對瑞士法郎的即期、遠期交易。而銀行理財在債券通“南向通”的首筆交易，由招銀理財和交行香港分行達成。據交行香港分行，在債券通“南向通”參與主體擴容後，該行主動對接理財公司，並迅速完成相關交易籌備流程。另據記者獨家從業內多方確認，另外兩家獲得債券通“南向通”首批資格的理財公司，是兩家國有行理財公司。（ 證券時報  ）

Brent Extends Decline for Fifth Straight Session — Brent fell toward $78 per barrel on Wednesday, sliding for the fifth straight session and reaching its lowest level since early March, as expectations of increased supply continued to weigh on prices ahead of the signing of a peace agreement between the US and Iran. The two countries are scheduled to sign an interim deal in Switzerland on Friday, offering Tehran broad economic incentives, including the immediate resumption of its oil exports. Tankers from other nations are also expected to resume passage through the Strait of Hormuz once the agreement takes effect, although shipping companies remain cautious about its long-term durability. Oil Extends Decline for Fifth Straight Session — Crude oil fell toward $75 per barrel on Wednesday, sliding for the fifth straight session and reaching its lowest level since early March, as expectations of increased supply continued to weigh on prices ahead of the signing of a peace agreement between the US and Iran. The two countries are scheduled to sign an interim deal in Switzerland on Friday, offering Tehran broad economic incentives, including the immediate resumption of its oil exports. Tankers from other nations are also expected to resume passage through the Strait of Hormuz once the agreement takes effect, although shipping companies remain cautious about its long-term durability. Additional supplies from the region are expected to replenish refinery inventories globally, alongside higher OPEC+ export quotas and increased output from the UAE, which left the cartel during the conflict. Meanwhile, industry data showed that US crude inventories declined by 8.3 million barrels last week.

【廣東釋出山洪災害風險預警】廣東省水利廳6月17日9時釋出山洪災害風險預警：根據氣象降雨預報分析，預計未來24小時，茂名高州市、化州市、信宜市，陽江陽東區，湛江廉江市，局地發生山洪災害可能性大（橙色預警）。肇慶高要區、懷集縣，惠州博羅縣、龍門縣，雲浮云城區、雲安區、新興縣、羅定市，汕尾陸豐市，江門台山市、開平市、鶴山市、恩平市，廣州增城區，湛江遂溪縣，清遠佛岡縣、連山壯族瑤族自治縣，茂名電白區，陽江陽春市，佛山高明區，局地發生山洪災害可能性較大（黃色預警）。其他地區也可能因局地短歷時強降水引發山洪災害。請各地密切關注天氣預報及雨水情變化，結合實際加強研判，做好實時監測、防汛預警和轉移避險等防範工作。請相關地區公眾留意預報預警資訊，增強災害防範避險意識，儘量避免前往山丘區溝溪、河灘地等低窪區域，確保自身生命財產安全。（央視新聞）

【SAFE Director Zhu Hexin: Foundation for Global Openness Remains Solid; Cross‑border Allocation Momentum Strong】At the Lujiazui Forum opening, PBOC vice governor and State Administration of Foreign Exchange director Zhu Hexin said since 2020 global instability and uncertainty have risen, and capital flows now exhibit 'volatility, divergence and resilience.' He flagged three market features: first, global financial conditions have shifted rapidly, with higher international market volatility and increased capital‑flow volatility amid changes in financial structure; second, global capital is reallocating toward future industries — notably artificial intelligence, semiconductors, biomanufacturing and the energy transition — widening dispersion across countries, sectors and assets; third, the foundation for global openness and cooperation remains solid and cross‑border private allocation momentum is strong. Zhu said global financial system resilience has continued to improve and many emerging economies, including China, have richer macro policy and macroprudential experience, enhancing their capacity to withstand external shocks.

【國家外匯管理局局長朱鶴新：全球開放合作的基礎依然堅實，各類主體跨境配置資源的內生動力強勁】在2026陸家嘴論壇開幕式上，中國人民銀行副行長、國家外匯管理局局長朱鶴新表示，2020年以來，世界動盪變革，不穩定不確定因素增多，全球資本流動呈現出“波動、分化與韌性”的新特徵。一是全球金融條件快速變化，國際金融市場波動增加，疊加金融結構變化影響，資本流動的波動性上升。二是全球資金進一步向人工智慧、半導體、生物製造、能源轉型等未來產業集聚，不同國家、行業和資產之間分化加大。三是全球開放合作的基礎依然堅實，各類主體跨境配置資源的內生動力強勁。全球金融體系韌性也持續提升，包括中國在內的許多新興經濟體，宏觀調控政策和宏觀審慎管理經驗更加豐富，抵禦外部衝擊能力增強。（21財經）

【Korean retail investors snap up nearly $800 mln on SpaceX listing day】South Korean retail investors net-bought $796 mln of SpaceX shares on the company's listing day, data from the Korea Securities Depository showed, signaling strong demand after many retail investors were excluded from the IPO. SpaceX (SPCX.O) became the most popular U.S. stock among roughly 14 mln Korean retail investors; the single-day net purchase exceeded cumulative net buys for any U.S. stock over the past three months. Unlike Japan and Australia, Korea did not open direct retail access to the IPO; underwriter Mirae Asset Securities offered allocations to selected clients but ultimately received no shares. The Korea Financial Supervisory Service has broadened an investigation into the broker to determine why it failed to secure SpaceX allocations.

【CITIC Securities H2 Outlook: AI and Energy/Chemicals Form a New Barbell】CITIC Securities says global economic resilience is being tested by the Middle East conflict; H2 will be dominated by coexisting supply shocks, policy constraints and investment support, with the persistence of oil-price shocks the primary variable for the global macro path. For China, policymakers are likely to shift H2 focus toward structural reform—curbing domestic over-competition (anti-involution) and enforcing carbon assessments to optimize supply, while using fiscal and tax reform to steer demand. In China’s A-share market, AI plus energy/chemicals form a new barbell. Investment stance: keep a global lens on China and adopt K-shaped positioning rather than simple bull/bear views; move from “building AI” to “adapting to AI” in technology exposure. The long-term investment case remains a re-rating of China’s advantaged manufacturing pricing power; priority sectors are new energy, chemicals, nonferrous metals and power equipment. On the offensive side, monitor domestic AI progress and overweight the domestic compute chain and cloud platforms. Continue selective overweight of low-valuation names, notably brokers and insurers.
【吳清：平穩推動液化天然氣期貨期權上市】6月17日，在2026陸家嘴論壇開幕式上，中國證監會主席吳清表示，將增強“上海價格”國際影響力，平穩推動液化天然氣期貨期權上市，支援推進電力等基礎性、戰略性期貨品種研發。
【證監會主席吳清：支援上海打造金融創新“試驗田” 打造首批資本市場科技金融實踐樣本】2026陸家嘴論壇今日上午開幕，中國證券監督管理委員會主席吳清在發表主題演講時表示，助力加快建設上海國際金融中心。增強“上海價格”國際影響力，支援上海打造金融創新“試驗田”，打造首批資本市場科技金融實踐樣本，助力上海國際金融中心軟實力提升。
【吳清：打造首批資本市場科技金融實踐樣本】以“全球治理倡議下的金融發展與合作：新願景、新挑戰和新機遇”為主題的2026陸家嘴論壇6月17日在滬開幕。中國證監會主席吳清表示，打造首批資本市場科技金融實踐樣本，包括上海浦東、北京海淀、廣東深圳、江蘇蘇州、浙江杭州。

【CSRC chair Wu Qing says regulator will support lawful cross-border investment and financing and step up cross-border supervision】On June 17 at the 2026 Lujiazui Forum, CSRC chair Wu Qing said the commission will strengthen cross-border supervisory cooperation, support lawful and compliant cross-border investment and financing, and lawfully crack down on cross-border illegal and non-compliant activities.
【臺灣“軍情局”或有美軍首度進駐 國臺辦回應】國務院臺辦舉行例行新聞釋出會。有記者問：臺媒近日報道，今年以來，臺灣“軍情局”第一次有美軍進駐，推測是合作“監聽大陸”。請問發言人對此有何評論？發言人陳斌華表示，我們堅決反對美國與中國臺灣地區開展任何形式的軍事聯絡。民進黨當局蓄意升高兩岸對立對抗，在“倚外謀獨”“以武謀獨”的邪路上走得越遠，就越會自取滅亡。
【證監會主席吳清：支援合法合規的跨境投融資活動，依法打擊各類跨境違法違規行為】6月17日，證監會主席吳清在2026陸家嘴論壇上表示，著力提升跨境監管協作力度，支援合法合規的跨境投融資活動，依法打擊各類跨境違法違規行為。

【CSRC chair Wu Qing: to continue deepening STAR Market and ChiNext reforms】CSRC chair Wu Qing said regulators will continue to deepen reforms of the STAR Market and ChiNext to implement a strategy to develop future industries. Authorities will support listings of more hard-tech firms, citing quantum technology, biomanufacturing and embodied intelligence, and will orderly push further ChiNext reform while stepping up support for new consumption and modern services to better serve growth-stage innovative and entrepreneurial companies.

【國際能源署：伊朗戰事暴露東南亞能源安全風險】國際能源署16日釋出報告說，伊朗戰事引發的能源危機給東南亞地區能源安全敲響警鐘，若不盡快改變能源供應渠道單一的情況，該地區能源進口成本將大幅增加。報告說，東南亞地區過度依賴經霍爾木茲海峽運輸的石油和天然氣產品。因此，當伊朗戰事導致全球能源供應緊張時，該地區的能源安全尤為脆弱。國際能源署署長法提赫·比羅爾說，對東南亞地區而言，實現能源供應來源多元化是當務之急。
【證監會主席吳清：支援在滬深交易所推出主動ETF】中國證監會主席吳清17日在2026陸家嘴論壇上表示，進一步豐富投資產品和工具，包括：支援在滬深交易所推出主動ETF；推出商業不動產REITs試點，4單首批專案18日將在上交所掛牌上市；推出支援中小基金公司規範健康發展的一攬子措施，堅持分類監管、突出特色，在產品佈局、業務准入等方面給予適當傾斜，支援中小基金公司差異化發展。
【算力租賃概念震盪反彈 東陽光回封漲停】算力租賃概念盤中震盪反彈，東陽光回封漲停，此前智微智慧封漲停，協創資料、南凌科技、行雲科技、宏景科技跟漲。
【周志銘任水井坊法定代表人】天眼查App顯示，近日，水井坊（600779）發生工商變更，胡庭洲卸任法定代表人、總經理，由周志銘接任。該公司成立於1993年12月，註冊資本約4.9億人民幣，經營範圍包括食品生產、食品銷售、食品新增劑生產等，由四川成都水井坊集團有限公司、香港中央結算有限公司、邱偉珉等共同持股。

【Yadea, Cainiao reach digital cooperation】Yadea Technology Group and Cainiao have agreed a digital cooperation and held a kick-off for an accessories supply-and-sales central platform project. Cainiao will assist Yadea in building a "flexible supply chain system".

【知乎上線“高考資料通” 首次納入就業行情】高考落下帷幕之際，知乎第二年上線資料工具“高考資料通”。據介紹，該工具基於2600餘所高校的招生錄取趨勢及超7萬個“大學+專業”組合的錄取資訊大資料構建，並整合了1739個專業在359個城市就業市場的最新薪資情況，為考生提供精準的志願報錄與未來職業發展參考。目前，“高考資料通”面向所有知乎使用者免費開放。後續，知乎直答還將升級“AI智搜”功能，在搜尋場景中接入高考錄取、就業薪資、研途考研等資料，充分發揮AI時代資料的價值，助力考生做出更科學的志願決策。（新浪科技）
Vietnam deputy finance minister says 1H trade deficit expected at about $15bln.
越南財政部副部長：越南上半年貿易逆差預計約為150億美元。
【雅迪與菜鳥達成數字化合作】近日，雅迪科技集團與菜鳥已達成數字化合作，雙方舉辦了配件供銷中臺專案啟動會。此次合作中，菜鳥將助力雅迪打造“柔性供應鏈體系”。

【Wu Qing backs foreign-owned securities, fund and futures firms in China; urges expansion of fund-advisory pilot】CSRC chairman Wu Qing said the regulator supports foreign investors establishing wholly foreign‑owned or joint‑venture securities, fund and futures firms in China, and encourages licensed foreign institutions to participate in an expanded pilot for fund-advisory services.
Vietnam's deputy finance minister said he expects exports to accelerate over the remainder of the year, helping to narrow the country's trade deficit.
【吳清：鼓勵外資持牌機構參與基金投顧業務擴大試點】6月17日，在2026陸家嘴論壇開幕式上，中國證監會主席吳清表示，支援外資在華新設獨資或合資證券基金期貨機構，鼓勵外資持牌機構參與基金投顧業務擴大試點等。
【證監會主席吳清：支援香港推出五年期人民幣國債期貨上市交易】17日在2026陸家嘴論壇上，中國證監會主席吳清表示，支援香港推出五年期人民幣國債期貨上市交易。(新華財經)
越南財政部副部長：預計今年剩餘時間出口增速將加快，以縮小貿易逆差。
【吳清：會同人民銀行研究推進人民幣外匯期貨試點】證監會主席吳清表示，著力提升開放制度的吸引力和競爭力，會同人民銀行研究推進人民幣外匯期貨試點。（證券時報）

【Wu Qing: CSRC to study pilot of RMB FX futures with PBOC】CSRC chairman Wu Qing said the regulator, working with the People’s Bank of China, will study and advance a pilot program for RMB foreign-exchange futures to boost the attractiveness and competitiveness of China’s opening-up framework.

【China's first G8.6 AMOLED line in Chengdu enters mass production; design capacity 32,000 glass substrates/month】BOE's G8.6 AMOLED production line in Chengdu Hi‑Tech Zone entered mass production today. Total investment is 63 billion yuan and design capacity is 32,000 glass substrates/month. The line will produce high‑end touch OLED panels for notebooks and tablets and will also support smartphone displays. It is Sichuan's largest single industrial investment to date.

【FF釋出四款機器人 落地首個EAI教育生態】6月17日，Faraday Future（簡稱“FF”）官微訊息，正式釋出首個“三位一體”EAI機器人教育生態戰略，推出全新Futurist（2027款）與FX Navi等四款機器人。其中，FX Navi為全美首款EAI啟蒙型四足機器人，專為家庭與教育場景打造，配套全美首個EAI STEM課程體系；該機器人本體售價1990美元，即日開啟銷售與交付。同時，FF與教育合作伙伴攜手，打造同時面向To B教育機構與To C家庭教育的機器人教育生態。
【潘功勝盤點中國金融市場30年成績單：深度廣度大幅提升 國際地位與影響力實現跨越式提升】6月17日，在2026陸家嘴論壇上，中國人民銀行行長潘功勝表示，30多年來，特別是黨的十八大以來，中國金融市場逐步從最初以信貸市場為主，發展成為包括股票、債券、貨幣、黃金、票據、大宗商品、衍生品等各金融子市場協同發展、功能健全、種類完備的現代金融市場體系，有力助推了中國經濟穩定增長、轉型升級和高質量發展。
【半導體產業鏈持續走強 華虹宏力漲超8%創歷史新高】半導體產業鏈盤中持續走強，華虹宏力漲超8%，創歷史新高，A+H股總市值超2800億，甬矽電子漲超10%，通富微電逼近漲停，長電科技、華天科技、紫光國微、中微公司、中芯國際等紛紛跟漲。

【上海國際金融中心發展離岸金融行動方案：穩步促進數字人民幣在離岸業務中的應用和場景拓展】中國人民銀行、國家發展改革委、金融監管總局、中國證監會、國家外匯局和上海市人民政府聯合印發《上海國際金融中心發展離岸金融行動方案》。方案提出，依託數字人民幣國際運營中心，在安全可控前提下建設和運營數字人民幣跨境、離岸和區塊鏈基礎設施，穩妥推進與境外金融基礎設施的互聯互通，穩步促進數字人民幣在離岸業務中的應用和場景拓展。（央行）
Vietnam's deputy finance minister said the government will maintain a 10% GDP growth target for this year despite facing challenges.
越南財政部副部長表示：儘管面臨挑戰，越南仍堅持今年國內生產總值（GDP）增長10%的目標。
【中國首條第8.6代AMOLED生產線在成都量產 設計產能為每月3.2萬片玻璃基板】據成都商報，6月17日，由BOE（京東方）投建的中國首條第8.6代AMOLED生產線在成都高新區正式實現量產。該生產線總投資630億元，設計產能為每月3.2萬片玻璃基板，是四川省迄今投資體量最大的單體工業專案。該生產線主要生產膝上型電腦、平板電腦等智慧終端的高階觸控OLED顯示屏，同時兼顧手機顯示產品。
【臺美防務合作預算暴增 國臺辦：拿錢開路 蠅營狗苟 讓人不齒】國務院臺辦舉行例行新聞釋出會。有記者問：近日，島內有輿論質疑臺防務部門2026年度預算中，“臺美防務部門共同合作評估案”預算由去年的41萬美元暴增至500萬美元，是巧立名目、給美國送保護費。請問發言人對此有何評論？發言人陳斌華表示，民進黨當局為了“謀獨”拒統不擇手段，拿錢開路，蠅營狗苟，讓人不齒。
【證監會主席吳清：嚴查嚴處借科技之名蹭熱點、炒概念甚至操縱市場，內幕交易等違法違規行為】2026陸家嘴論壇今日上午開幕，中國證券監督管理委員會主席吳清在發表主題演講時表示，持續提升監管效能和適應性。完善市場準入、持續監管、退出等各環節監管機制。嚴查嚴處借科技之名蹭熱點、炒概念甚至操縱市場，內幕交易等違法違規行為。

【CSRC chairman Wu Qing: strong support for corporate M&A and refinancing; back eligible Hong Kong-listed firms' onshore listings】CSRC chairman Wu Qing said in a keynote speech the regulator will strongly support listed companies' M&A and refinancing, further boost M&A and restructuring activity, deepen refinancing reforms, and support eligible Hong Kong-listed companies' onshore listings.

【臺灣民生“痛苦指數”飆升 國臺辦：民進黨當局心中只有政治私利】國務院臺辦舉行例行新聞釋出會。有記者問：近來，民進黨當局稱臺灣經濟資料亮眼，但有輿論指出，島內經濟增長並未惠及大多數普通民眾，面對就業困難、物價上漲等困境，臺灣民生“痛苦指數”在飆升。請問對此有何評論？發言人陳斌華表示，經濟發展目的是改善民生，讓民眾過上更好的日子。而民進黨當局對外卑躬屈膝，對內巧取豪奪。在民進黨當局鼓吹的經濟資料之下，島內物價、電價等連番上漲，貧富差距拉大。普通民眾的“被剝奪感”與日俱增，“痛苦指數”持續飆升。面臨種種事實和民眾不滿，民進黨當局不是面對問題著力解決產業民生切膚之痛，反而自吹自擂，充分證明他們的心中只有政治私利，全無民生福祉，必將更失人心。
Vietnam's deputy finance minister said higher fuel costs in 1H widened the trade deficit.
【吳清：適時釋出規範發展資本市場人工智慧的指導意見】6月17日，在2026陸家嘴論壇開幕式上，中國證監會主席吳清表示，將適時釋出規範發展資本市場人工智慧的指導意見。

【CSRC chair Wu Qing urges Chinese pension and insurance funds to boost equity allocations】China's CSRC chair Wu Qing said authorities will broaden funding sources, support complementarities between state capital funds and private capital, and guide pension and insurance funds to increase equity allocations to help smooth the fundraising-investment-management-exit cycle.

【民進黨當局被曝“正考慮對向大陸銷售人工智慧晶片實施嚴厲管制”，國臺辦回應】6月17日上午，國臺辦舉行例行新聞釋出會，發言人陳斌華就近期兩岸熱點問題回答記者提問。記者：據彭博社報道，民進黨當局正考慮對向大陸銷售人工智慧晶片實施嚴厲管制，擬將未經授權的相關出口行為定性為刑事犯罪。島內輿論認為這是賴清德當局向美國遞出的“投名狀”，若執意如此，將導致臺灣半導體產業陷入孤立。請問對此有何評論？陳斌華：如果報道屬實，將進一步印證民進黨當局為“倚美謀獨”，在推動兩岸產業“脫鉤斷鏈”上已經喪心病狂。濫用司法破壞兩岸產業鏈供應鏈的做法，違背市場經濟規律，壓制臺灣半導體產業發展空間，到頭來只會搬起石頭砸自己的腳，導致臺灣核心產業優勢加快喪失。大陸正加快高質量發展，在晶片、人工智慧等領域不斷取得新突破，國產大模型引領全球開源生態，腦機介面實現從“實驗室理論探索”到“臨床初步應用”的關鍵跨越，新質生產力迅猛發展，產業智慧化、綠色化、融合化發展日新月異，為兩岸在相關領域優勢互補、合作共贏不斷開拓更為廣闊空間。我們歡迎廣大臺灣企業前來大陸，擁抱發展的確定性，把握髮展的主動權，在穩定、開放、創新的環境中實現自身更大更好發展。
【證監會主席吳清：大力支援上市公司併購及再融資 支援符合條件的港股上市公司境內上市】2026陸家嘴論壇今日上午開幕，中國證券監督管理委員會主席吳清在發表主題演講時表示，大力支援上市公司併購及再融資。進一步激發併購重組活力，深化再融資改革，支援符合條件的港股上市公司境內上市。
【吳清：引導養老金、保險資金等加大股權投資力度】以“全球治理倡議下的金融發展與合作：新願景、新挑戰和新機遇”為主題的2026陸家嘴論壇6月17日在滬開幕。證監會主席吳清表示，積極拓寬資金來源，支援國資基金與社會資本優勢互補，引導養老金、保險資金等加大股權投資力度，促進進一步暢通“募投管退”迴圈。
【證監會主席吳清：用好用足併購重組快速稽核機制】中國證監會主席吳清17日在2026陸家嘴論壇上表示，用好用足併購重組快速稽核機制，積極打通併購實施過程中的堵點卡點，推動最佳化併購相關政策，降低交易成本。
【證監會主席吳清：有序推進深化創業板改革 加大對新型消費和現代服務業的支援力度】中國證監會主席吳清17日在2026陸家嘴論壇上表示，有序推進深化創業板改革，加大對新型消費和現代服務業的支援力度，更好服務成長型創新創業企業發展。

【潘功勝：銀行間市場資料包告庫正式掛牌 提升對金融市場穿透監測能力】6月17日，在2026陸家嘴論壇上，中國人民銀行行長潘功勝宣佈，銀行間市場資料包告庫正式掛牌。透過集中收集交易、託管、結算等資料資訊，提升對金融市場的穿透監測能力，服務於監管，服務於市場。此外，去年宣佈設立的上海數字人民幣國際運營中心已全面投入運營，數字人民幣跨境結算綜合服務平臺（數幣達 CBETS）也已正式上線。

【我國沙化土地面積年均縮減1000萬畝】記者從國家林草局獲悉，我國沙化土地面積持續淨減少，由上世紀末的年均擴充套件515萬畝轉變為目前的年均縮減1000萬畝。資料顯示，八大沙漠、四大沙地的土壤風蝕總量較2000年下降約40%，沙區植被平均蓋度達21.17%，較10年前上升2.84%。“三北”工程區林草覆蓋率達40.76%，67.82%的可治理沙化土地得到治理。據介紹，近年來我國以打好打贏“三北”工程攻堅戰為重點，全面推進荒漠化防治。“三北”工程三大標誌性戰役打響以來，累計下達中央投資889億元，組織實施重點專案544個，完成建設任務2.44億畝。“十五五”是縱深推進全國防沙治沙和打好“三北”工程攻堅戰的攻堅期和決勝期。下一步，各地各部門將緊扣規劃目標任務，堅持分類保護、分割槽治理，推進重點區域沙化土地綜合治理，適度發展綠色沙產業。力爭到2030年，全國完成沙化土地治理任務近1億畝，四大沙地、沙漠綠洲、青藏高原、黃河流域、京津冀周邊等重點區域生態狀況顯著改善。（新華社）

【國臺辦：民進黨當局對日菲嚴重侵權行徑卑躬屈膝 已淪為民族敗類】國務院臺辦舉行例行新聞釋出會。有記者問：大陸在臺灣東部海域開展海上交通專項執法行動，民進黨當局稱，大陸無權以任何理由對臺灣東部海域主張執法權。請問發言人對此有何評論？發言人陳斌華表示，世界上只有一箇中國，臺灣是中國一部分，日菲宣佈的擬劃界海域位於臺灣島以東，中國在上述海域擁有專屬經濟區和大陸架。日菲繞開中國擅自啟動所謂“劃界談判”嚴重違反國際法和國際關係基本準則，嚴重侵害中國海洋權益，完全非法無效。大陸海警在臺灣島以東海域依法開展執法巡查，是針對日菲嚴重侵犯中國領土主權和海域權益採取的必要行動，並將繼續加強對有關海域的管控。民進黨當局對日菲的嚴重侵權行徑卑躬屈膝，出賣民族利益，淪為民族敗類，已經遭到包括臺灣同胞在內的兩岸同胞的反對和唾棄，其企圖升高兩岸對立的做法說法，不過是在轉移壓力欺騙民眾。

【XREAL to launch first lightweight spatial computing XR glasses in fall 2026】XREAL unveiled its first lightweight spatial computing XR glasses, the XREAL AURA, and opened overseas pre-orders. XREAL plans an initial rollout in the US, UK, Japan, Canada and South Korea in fall 2026, with subsequent expansion into Europe and other markets.

【PBOC, other regulators back expansion of offshore trade finance pilot in Shanghai FTZ Lingang New Area】The PBOC and other regulators' Action Plan directs optimizing offshore trade finance services and supports expanding the comprehensive offshore trade finance reform pilot in the Shanghai FTZ Lingang New Area. It allows global high-quality traders to establish offshore trade specialist companies to provide payment, settlement and financing for offshore trade. The plan backs the "Cross-Border Tong" and "Offshore Tong" platforms in further integrating global customs, logistics and other data to support offshore trade finance. Priority will be given to offshore trade finance tied to bulk commodity trading and other areas with an existing foundation; the offshore trade finance management model may be extended to additional trade scenarios when appropriate.
